1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Admin Workflows area of 1Password's Enterprise Password Manager (EPM). With our API first approach to EPM, you will champion API centric workflows and deliver features that help administrators manage, monitor, and support their organizations at scale. You'll shape a roadmap spanning admin capabilities, admin dashboards and reporting, notification systems, account recovery and user confirmation workflows, and agentic (MCP) capabilities — connecting deep platform decisions to customer and business outcomes. This role sits at the center of the enterprise admin experience, with dependencies across many partner teams, so strong cross-functional judgment and communication are essential.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.




HOW WE'RE USING AI TODAY

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.




OUR PRODUCT PHILOSOPHY

Our philosophy on Product consists of five core pillars:

 - Focus and Execution — can you ship quickly and measure results?

 - Customer Empathy — are you motivated first and foremost to solve customer problems?

 - Effective Communication — can you bring the entire organization — horizontally and vertically — along on the journey?

 - Go To Market — can you understand and drive the business outcomes through product decisions?

 - Technology — articulating how our technology beats our competitors.

Product Managers play a highly visible role in the company and are critical to the development and execution of our product strategy. As PMs, we are responsible for setting and championing the high bar for our products. You must excel at prioritization, collaboration, and communication, while holding yourself and others accountable for measuring quality and business results. You'll work with other PMs to understand customer problems and define requirements so your engineering counterparts can create great solutions, and you'll take a holistic view of customer needs that cross buyers, users, and administrators. You will work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and GTM teams to ensure the quality, security, and usability of the service.



What we're looking for:

 - 5+ years of product management experience owning a product or a set of features and being responsible for its ultimate success, in B2B or enterprise software

 - A track record of shipping and improving software and driving business impact through the features or products you owned

 - Experience building for administrator or IT personas — workflows, dashboards, APIs, or enterprise governance capabilities

 - Strong experience with API first product design, API development, and API management workflows, with the technical depth to engage directly with system architecture and developer documentation

 - An action-bias that won't wait to create change

 - Obsession with internal and external customer problems, and the ability to represent the voice of the customer to motivate the team

 - Strong presentation and leadership skills

 - Excellent verbal and written communi

Security isn't a feature at 1Password. It is the product. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape security strategy across the company, working with Security Engineering, who hold one of the highest technical bars in the industry, and with the product teams building everything our customers touch.


You'll be the bridge. You'll understand cryptographic and architectural detail well enough to earn the trust of our security engineers, and you'll translate what matters into clear priorities for feature teams. Just as importantly, you'll bring a deep respect for the customer: a security control nobody can stand to use makes everyone less safe. You'll help us find the design that's both rigorous and usable, and have the credibility to say so in a room full of experts



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product teams on security early. Work with PMs and feature teams to understand their upcoming roadmaps, identify security requirements and threat-model implications before designs are locked, and make sure those needs are visible, prioritized, and resourced.

 - Align Security Engineering with product strategy. Translate feature-team needs into prioritized security work, and make Security Engineering's priorities legible to the rest of the company so tradeoffs are made in the open.

 - Own an independent security roadmap. Set direction for platform-level security investments, such as key management and recovery, the cryptographic foundations of our zero-knowledge architecture, authentication, and our long-term readiness for post-quantum cryptography.

 - Lead our strategy for the AI era. Define how 1Password approaches agentic access to credentials, secrets for non-human identities and AI agents, and the trust models emerging around tools and protocols like MCP.

 - Balance risk and usability with evidence. Help security engineers weigh real-world risk against user friction, using adoption, support, and telemetry data alongside threat models. Shipping with accepted, documented residual risk is sometimes the right call, and you'll help us make and defend those decisions.

 - Represent 1Password to the security community. Engage with security researchers and our bug bounty program, speak at conferences, and contribute to the wider conversation about where credential security is heading.

 - Raise the bar for product work. Coach PMs on security thinking, challenge assumptions constructively, and set the standard for how security-critical product work gets done.

adobe:R173022.desc:
The opportunity   
 Help shape how AI transforms the way enterprises deliver customer experiences!   
 CX Coworker is Adobe’s agentic AI layer across the Customer Experience portfolio, designed to help practitioners turn business intent into action across Adobe applications, within their organization’s governance controls.   
 We have a fantastic opportunity to lead product strategy and discovery for CX Coworker Customer Pods!   
 These time-limited co-development engagements pair enterprise customer practitioners with focused, cross-functional Adobe teams spanning product, engineering, design, and customer-facing functions. Together, they explore priority business problems, prototype agentic workflows, and validate product hypotheses in the customer's environment. The collaboration creates a direct feedback loop between customer experimentation and Adobe's product teams, helping inform our broader product strategy.   
 As a Principal Product Manager, you’ll connect hands-on customer findings with Adobe’s broader product strategy. You’ll align customer and Adobe collaborators on the problems worth solving. You will guide prioritization across engagements and work with core product teams to develop reusable capabilities from validated solutions. Success means more than delivering a compelling customer pilot: it means identifying what should scale, influencing cross-product investment decisions, and building a repeatable path from customer experimentation to trusted, broadly valuable product experiences.   
 The role spans Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), relevant AEP & Apps products, and Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker.   
 What you'll do   
 Own the discovery, prioritization, and productization of agentic customer workflows validated through Customer Pods, translating customer co-innovation into scalable Coworker and AEP product investments.   
 Turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product direction, requirements, prototypes, and acceptance criteria. Partner with engineering and design on feasibility, architecture trade-offs, and execution while maintaining a hands-on connection to the customer experience.   
 Identify platform gaps required to enable scalable agentic workflows, including missing APIs, permissions models, governance controls, workflow primitives, and product capabilities. Partner with platform and application teams to define requirements and prioritize foundational investments.   
 Own the AI evaluation framework across Pods, defining workflow success and task completion metrics, error rates, human intervention rates, and adoption metrics. Partner with engineering and design to establish evaluation datasets, quality thresholds, and instrumentation.   
 Lead the definition of strategic workflows across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and CJA / Analytics, such as turning an analytical insight into an audience, activating a customer journey, and measuring its impact. Prioritize opportunities with repeatable value across customers and industries.   
 Align Coworker and application product leaders on shared outcomes, roadmap dependencies, and investment trade-offs. Build evidence-based cases and distinguish scalable product opportunities from customer-specific implementation work.   
 Shape product requirements for trustworthy AI-assisted and autonomous workflows. Partner with engineering, security, privacy, and governance teams on human approvals, permissions, evaluation, monitoring, and safe recovery when tasks cannot be completed.   
 Drive the path from customer validation to productization with core product teams. Synthesize learning across Pods into reusable workflow templates, prioritized platform gaps, and explicit recommendations on what to scale, iterate, or stop.   
 Influence customer and Adobe executives through clear product narratives, investment recommendations, and candid trade-offs. Partner with product marketing and field leaders to turn validated outcomes into enablement and compelling customer value stories.   
 What you'll need to succeed   
 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record of defining and delivering complex enterprise software products from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.   
 Deep customer empathy and experience leading enterprise design partnerships or co-development programs. Earn executive trust, navigate competing priorities, and turn individual customer needs into broadly valuable product decisions.   
 Strong domain expertise in customer data platforms, journey orchestration, marketing technology, or analytics, with depth in at least one area and a demonstrated ability to define connected experiences across products.   
 Technical fluency in data ingestion, schemas, identity, APIs, integrations, and governance. Engage architects and engineering leaders on platform trade-offs, scalability, and extensibility, connecting technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 The Opportunity 
 Adyen operates as a full-stack payment processor and licensed global banking institution, capturing the behavior and complex interactions of billions of shoppers and millions of businesses worldwide. As we scale our footprint in banking, card issuing, and embedded financial products, the financial risk profiles we manage are significantly higher than traditional payment processing alone. We are leveraging our unique position to build advanced, data-driven risk management capabilities to proactively detect and mitigate platform fraud and commercial risk. 
 We are looking for a Group Product Manager (GPM) to lead and develop a senior team of product managers within Adyen’s Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud group. This is not a standard product role. We need an all-around biztech leader who possesses strong technical instincts but treats the domain like a high-growth business, balancing architecture with a commercial mindset, regulatory strategy, and high-friction cross-functional alignment. 
 What You'll Do 
 Drive Commercial Excellence: Formulate and execute a strategic vision that transforms risk mitigation into customer value. Treat these premium, paid capabilities like your own business, balancing pricing strategy, revenue drivers, and costs to ensure responsible growth.
 Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct, coach, and elevate a team of high-performing product managers within Adyen’s Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud group.
 Architect Smart Trade-offs: Simplify an ambiguous space by defining clear, actionable use cases with your engineering and partner teams. Strategically decide when to deploy automated technical solutions (such as AI/ML models) versus operational support to optimize merchant value.
 Pragmatic Regulatory Strategy: Act as the ultimate product authority for Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud across Adyen. Partner closely with Compliance, Regulatory, and Operations teams to design resilient, auditable capabilities, bringing a pragmatic commercial lens to regulatory interpretation rather than blindly following rigid frameworks.
 Lead Through Friction: Drive alignment and partner closely with Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and Operations teams without direct authority. Raise the bar for product clarity and prioritization discipline, making the tough, objective trade-offs necessary to unlock long-term value, even when it means saying "no" to specific groups.
 Who You Are 
 Accelerated Product Leader: You have 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of progression into leadership roles. You have launched and evolved complex products across every stage of the product lifecycle.
 People Manager & Coach: You bring hands-on experience hiring, managing, and developing product managers of various levels, with a proven ability to build a collaborative culture of growth, coaching, and mentorship.
 Commercial GM Mindset: You bring a highly analytical, metrics-driven approach to decision-making. You deeply understand revenue drivers, costs, and portfolio management, behaving with the strategic accountability of a P&L owner to optimize business outcomes.
 Strong Tech & AI/ML Instincts: You have a solid conceptual grasp of machine learning, AI, and advanced data-science models. While you don't need to be an ML engineer, you have the technical confidence to collaborate with engineering teams on building products rooted in petabyte-scale datasets.
 Master of Influence: You are a clear, confident, and fearless communicator across technical, commercial, and executive audiences globally. You have a track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing complex stakeholders without direct authority.

 The world's largest businesses run on Adyen. They manage their business in our portal, embed our components in their interfaces to serve their own users, and send their shoppers through our checkout. To them, it's all one product. It's built by many teams working in parallel, and whether it feels like one product depends on the foundations they share. You'll own the design system and technical frameworks those teams build on. You'll decide what gets built next, get teams across Adyen building on it, and set the standards that keep the experience consistent without slowing anyone down. Get this right, and building a great experience at Adyen becomes the default. Teams ship faster because they aren't rebuilding the basics, and merchants get an experience that holds together wherever they meet us.

 Own the design system and technical frameworks the rest of Adyen leverages to build first-class customer experiences. Decide what gets built next across UI components and the technical infrastructure that powers our customer experiences, and treat the engineers and designers who build on them as your customers.
 Sweat the details end customers see. Hold every component to a high bar, because it ends up in front of merchants, their users and their shoppers.

 Your primary focus is our domestic card schemes: the local alternatives to Visa and Mastercard that are cheaper and, in several markets, perform better, which makes them a real reason for merchants to choose and stay with us. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
 About the role 
 The Purchasing Experience product team owns the ‘face of Affirm’, the core checkout experience for millions of Affirm users.
 As a Senior Product Manager on the Terms and Payments team, you will be responsible for designing both the term and payment selection experiences which drive user clarity and confidence at checkout. 
An ideal candidate is one who has worked extensively on consumer experiences at key moments in the product flow. 
 This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and Analytics. 
 What you’ll do 
• Own the core checkout experience where consumers select and review their terms and payments — with a focus on driving conversion, clarity, and confidence at the moment of commitment.
• Design and run experiments that improve how consumers understand and choose their terms
• Define and ship new UX patterns that change the way checkout looks and feels — using research insights, quantitative signals, and close collaboration with design and analytics to move from discovery to launch.
• Partner with Legal and Compliance to understand regulatory requirements and how they affect the user experience.
• Work alongside international product partners to expand the terms experience into new markets, adapting for local expectations while keeping the design system coherent.
• Develop a deep understanding of user behavior and share those insights broadly — helping the team and stakeholders stay grounded in how consumers actually experience checkout.
• Drive an ambitious roadmap — identify the highest-leverage opportunities, align cross-functional partners, and own execution from concept through launch and iteration.
 What we look for

 - Proven ability to engage deeply with engineering on complex architectural discussions covering API design, distributed ledgers, high-throughput transaction processing, and hardware/software interfaces.

 - Exceptional analytical rigor with a track record of structuring complex ecosystem workflows, leveraging data to drive strategic trade-offs, and solving ambiguous problems.

 - High agency, persistence, and an entrepreneurial bias for action—capable of executing fast and driving complex initiatives to completion in a high-growth environment.

amazon:10459568.title: Sr Product Manager, Amazon Wholesale
amazon:10459568.desc:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the product strategy and execution for AWIPL — Amazon's only 1P retail entity for B2B in India. AWIPL exists to solve a fundamentally hard problem: the tools and playbooks that power Amazon's B2C businesses were never designed for the B2B operating model.
This is a zero-to-one product role. You will not inherit a mature product with an established tech stack. You will define what needs to be built, work with stakeholders for prioritization across 20+ cross-functional partner teams, write the BRDs and PRFAQs that make the business case, and own delivery end-to-end across multiple concurrent initiatives 
AWIPL serves two distinct B2B customer segments: SSR customers (small sole proprietors and independent retailers) and CPS customers (large enterprises like Infosys procuring at scale). Each segment has different selection, pricing, fulfillment, and credit requirements, and neither is adequately served by existing Amazon B2C tooling. You will close that gap at the foundational level.
The role carries broad scope and senior leadership visibility. You will present weekly to leadership team, align stakeholders across organizations, and operate in an environment where every product decision has a direct, measurable impact. 
Key job responsibilities
-Own the AWIPL product roadmap acros, spanning tools parity and scalable growth capabilities 
-Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical intake documents to secure engineering capacity from partner teams including WW AB Tech, SCOT, Recommerce, FC Ops, Tax Engine, and FinOps.
-Drive delivery of in-flight initiatives: 
-Define and execute the 3YF product vision.
-Leverage AI and automation to shift AWIPL from reactive firefighting to predictive decision-making: WBR diagnostic platforms, causal knowledge graphs, predictive OOS models, and CPS deal workflow automation eliminating 100+ hours/month of manual coordination.
-Communicate strategy, progress, and blockers to senior leaders weekly and align partner team leadership to prioritize AWIPL's roadmap asks above competing demands.
About the team
AWIPL is Amazon India's B2B retail entity, operating at the intersection of 1P retail and enterprise B2B. We are building Amazon Business India's supply chain from the ground up — solving problems that have no off-the-shelf answers, no existing playbooks, and no direct WW analogues. Our customers are Indian enterprises and retailers. Our opportunity is a $1.2T Indian retail market with only 7% e-commerce penetration and 15MM offline retailers underserved by traditional distribution.

amazon:10504416.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Global Transportation Technology Services
amazon:10504416.desc:
Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network - figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network - from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in Germany, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real-time, and keeping systems running 24/7.
We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.
Key job responsibilities
As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product portfolio. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, driving operational excellence, and shaping up the solutions to achieve our vision. This is your opportunity to make a big impact and make history in the world of Global Transportation!

SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.
We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows that tell sellers what happened, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.
As the Principal PM for SmartHub, you will define this next chapter. You will own the long-term product vision and roadmap for SmartHub and lead important horizontal capabilities such as pricing that span the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.
This is a role for a product builder who enjoys solving complex platform problems, operating in ambiguity and translating emerging technology into simple products that deliver measurable customer and business impact.

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce's multi-channel operations platform spanning order management, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and analytics.
Define how AI and agentic experiences can transform commerce operations — helping businesses move from manually operating software toward systems that understand business context, surface opportunities and risks, recommend decisions and automate repetitive work.
Reimagine high-frequency seller workflows such as order processing, inventory management, exception handling, returns and pricing to make operating across multiple sales channels dramatically simpler.
Lead horizontal product capabilities such as pricing that can create leverage across SmartHub and the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.
Develop a deep understanding of sellers ranging from emerging businesses to high-volume brands, including the operators who use SmartHub every day in warehouses and back offices.
Use customer research, product data and business insights to identify the highest-value problems and translate them into simple, scalable product experiences.
Partner deeply with engineering, science and UX teams on complex platform and AI problems, making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, reliability, scalability and speed.
Define and drive metrics across adoption, engagement, operational efficiency, seller experience and business impact.
Work across Amazon and external commerce ecosystems to build integrations and capabilities that allow businesses to operate seamlessly across marketplaces and D2C channels.
Influence senior leaders and partner teams across organizational boundaries to establish long-term product and technology direction.
Raise the product management bar through strong product judgment, first-principles thinking, clear written narratives and mentorship of other product leaders.

You might start the day speaking with a seller or warehouse operator processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and their own website, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow, review adoption and reliability metrics with the team, and then align senior leaders on a multi-year product strategy. You will move fluidly between warehouse-floor details, customer experience, platform architecture, AI possibilities and business strategy.
About the team
Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.
SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce — high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.
We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

amazon:10531853.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
amazon:10531853.desc:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. 
Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores. 
The Merchant In-Store Operations team within JWO owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education. Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day to day and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed. 
You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations—covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long-term Merchant In-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments. 
As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backward from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to think big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.
Key job responsibilities

You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. amazon:10551580.desc:
The AI Center of Excellence builds shared AI building blocks - primitives - that change how Amazon's systems work, not what features they ship. We take on the hardest problems first, prove each primitive with one partner on one real problem, then open it up so any team at Amazon can adopt what we've validated without solving it again.
We are looking for a Product Manager - Technical who can own the vision and lifecycle of these primitives, drive them from concept through adoption, and make sound product and technical trade-offs in a fast-moving AI domain.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the product lifecycle for AI primitives end-to-end - from customer discovery and problem framing through vision definition, roadmap prioritization, execution with cross-team dependencies, launch, and post-launch performance optimization
- Define product strategy by understanding problems that cut across multiple teams and personas - translating that into clear principles, requirements, and roadmap priorities that sequence work on evidence
- Drive adoption by partnering with early adopters, generalizing requirements from multiple contexts, and ensuring primitives work for any team without requiring your team to operate them
- Evaluate technical proposals alongside scientists and ML engineers - understanding architecture trade-offs and balancing feature delivery with system health and long-term maintainability
- Make crisp product decisions in ambiguous AI/ML domains where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined - using data, customer insight, and judgment
- Define success criteria that measure the primitive you own, not the partner's business outcome you don't - distinguishing adoption from real impact
- Ensure primitives are findable, adoptable, and valuable - not just built and opened
- Contribute to the team's rhythm of business - planning cycles, business reviews, goal tracking, and operational reporting
A day in the life
Every day brings new challenges. You might work backward from a partner team's pain point to frame a new primitive, review a technical design with scientists to assess whether an architecture can scale, or analyze adoption data to decide what to double down on versus deprecate. Other days, you'll write a vision document for a new capability, find new opportunities across the enterprise, or sit with early adopters to understand how they'd consume a primitive in their pipeline. You'll move between technical discussions with scientists and engineers and alignment conversations with senior managers and directors.
No two weeks look the same. You'll move between customer discovery, technical strategy, and hands-on execution - always building toward primitives that are trusted, consumable, and impactful at scale.
About the team
AICE is a team of scientists and machine learning engineers building the AI primitives that power Amazon's intelligent systems. We develop and harden reusable capabilities for broad consumption by product teams across the enterprise - and partner with those teams to integrate them.

Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.
Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.
A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.
About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.
That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr Product Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.
We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.
Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and feature prioritization through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.
A day in the life
As a Sr Product Manager in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify features for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of products for the Tax Services organization.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience with product cycles of 6+ months
- Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

amazon:10570181.title: Sr. Product Manager - Fleet Telematics (Fixed-Term contract), Fleet Safety & Technology
amazon:10570181.desc:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Product Manager, Telematics to lead the vision, roadmap, and global execution of our telematics product portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence, responsible for shaping how connected vehicle technology powers fleet safety, predictive maintenance, and operational efficiency across our last-mile delivery network. 
Based in Luxembourg or London, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy, vendor governance, and large-scale program delivery — driving outcomes across EU and global markets.
Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract. 
Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year telematics product strategy and roadmap, aligning with global fleet and last-mile delivery objectives across EU and international markets
- Lead end-to-end product development from discovery through scaled deployment, including requirements definition, prioritization, and executive stakeholder alignment
- Define and govern contractual relationships with telematics vendors, including leading commercial negotiations, SLA frameworks, performance accountability structures, and contract renewals
- Establish and maintain vendor governance mechanisms to ensure delivery against contractual commitments, data quality standards, and operational KPIs
- Partner with engineering, data science, legal, and operations teams to deliver telematics capabilities including real-time vehicle tracking, fault diagnostics, driver behavior monitoring, and predictive maintenance
- Drive adoption of telematics solutions across Delivery Service Partner (DSP) networks and internal fleet operations at scale
- Define, track, and report on key product metrics and use insights to continuously improve product outcomes
- Lead market and competitive analysis to identify emerging connected vehicle technologies and integration opportunities, including direct OEM integrations
- Ensure compliance with regional data privacy and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and EU-specific frameworks, in close collaboration with legal and privacy teams
- Communicate product strategy, roadmap progress, and business impact clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across geographies
About the team
The Fleet Safety & Technology (FS&T) team sits within International Global Fleet & Products (GFP). Our mission is to make Amazon's delivery fleet the safest, most technologically advanced, and most efficient in the industry — striving to eliminate all serious incidents through technology, data, and accountability.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience in fleet technology, IoT, connected vehicle platforms, or telematics
- Familiarity with OEM telematics integrations and connected vehicle data standards
- Knowledge of EV fleet management, battery health monitoring, or energy consumption analytics

amazon:10571904.title: Senior Product Manager — Billing and Accounting, Amazon Shipping
amazon:10571904.desc:
Ready to build Amazon's next $100B business? We're not just entering shipping, we're transforming how billions of packages move around the globe. By evolving Amazon's legendary fulfillment engine into an agile, intelligent shipping network, we're creating a system that continuously optimizes to deliver on time, every time, for every business and every customer. Every shipment is more than just a box, it spins the flywheel faster, enhancing our logistics network through scale, speed, and intelligence. As we increase density and reach, we're revolutionizing shipping for all businesses while strengthening Amazon's own delivery capabilities, reducing costs and accelerating deliveries across our entire ecosystem.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager for Billing and Accounting in Amazon Shipping. This role exists to make getting paid effortless and trustworthy for our shippers, and predictable and well-controlled for the business, as we consolidate fragmented, region-specific billing systems into a more standardized flow.
You'll own execution of defined product workstreams across the invoice-to-cash lifecycle: how charges are billed, how invoices are presented, how customers pay, how disputes and adjustments are resolved, and how transactions reconcile to the ledger. You'll drive consolidation of legacy and interim billing systems, close functional gaps, and ensure accurate, compliant, and controlled financial outcomes across every marketplace we operate in. You'll turn complex billing and accounting requirements into clear product definitions, and partner across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering to deliver them.
You'll work at the intersection of finance, operations, and engineering, translating regulatory, accounting, and customer requirements into crisp product requirements, and turning them into billing experiences that scale as the business grows.
You'll collaborate closely with:
-Billing Operations teams who manage day-to-day shipper interactions on invoices, payments, and disputes
-Payments and Credit Risk product owners whose capabilities your billing workstreams depend on
-Pricing teams introducing new charges and rate structures that our systems must bill for
-Accounting teams who own the ledger and require accurate, compliant, and controlled financial records
-Tax (VAT) teams who own compliance and filings
-Engineering teams building the billing and accounting platform
-Senior leadership setting financial strategy and controls for the business
WHO ARE YOU?
You're a product leader who is equally comfortable digging into an invoice reconciliation, writing a crisp product narrative, and walking an accounting or operations leader through a control tradeoff. You have strong product sense and build the right thing, not just build the thing right, within a defined charter. You bring real financial and data fluency, enough to partner credibly with accounting, tax, and finance on controls and compliance, and with engineers on data and systems, and you understand how billing, invoicing, and reconciliation actually get done day to day. You decompose an undefined problem space into a clear, sequenced set of deliverables, define the metrics that matter, and let them guide prioritization. You communicate crisply across functional, operations, and leadership audiences, and you balance a bias for action with the judgment to know a one-way door from a two-way door. You're a strong owner who is right a lot, and you measure success by customer and business outcomes, accurate billing, on-time payment, clean reconciliation, and reduced disputes, not features shipped. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where product decisions directly impact billing accuracy, reconciliation, dispute rates, and cash flow across a rapidly scaling business.
Key job responsibilities
Product Execution & Delivery
- Own execution of defined billing and accounting product workstreams within the charter, connecting accurate, frictionless financial experiences to growth and control across the business
- Write the product narratives and requirements that define new capabilities and drive alignment across operations, pricing, accounting, tax, and engineering
- Balance near-term operational and compliance needs with longer-term investment in a consolidated billing platform
- Work with engineering to deliver billing and accounting capabilities into the platform and the tools operations teams use every day
- Make sequencing and scope tradeoffs to deliver impact incrementally while protecting live financial operations
- Define clear acceptance criteria for operational and accounting adoption
Metrics & Business Impact
- Own billing accuracy and reconciliation outcomes as primary success measures, along with supporting measures of dispute rate and days-sales-outstanding
- Establish mechanisms for continuous visibility, baselining, and proactive risk identification

amazon:10572078.desc:
Amazon is seeking a Product Manager – Technical to join our Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) team, a team that uses technology and innovative methods to assess and improve Amazon’s customer experience. This person should be customer-obsessed, data-oriented, technologically hands-on, and excited to innovate.
You will be a core member of our product and engineering teams, driving the success of our products, tools, and capabilities to enable our organization to deliver insights and analysis at pace. We work across multiple Amazon Stores categories (e.g., consumer electronics, apparel) and tech teams (e.g., search, personalization), partnering with senior business leaders in strategically developing and improving the shopping experience on Amazon.
As our agentic-powered product suite has rapidly grown in recent months, with ever-increasing demand from users, we are looking for a PM-T who will focus on building and enhancing features of internal products and tools that drive insights and analysis across Amazon, enabling teams globally to improve end-to-end customer experiences.
The immediate objective is to own the vision, design and implementation for our next feature release, which will be a step change in how we evaluate Personalized shopping and streaming experiences worldwide. You will work with users, engineering, and leadership to drive alignment on requirements to ensure the product meets the high bar and provides a delightful experience.
A successful PM-T will be able to deeply understand the user needs, and experiences for features of our products, dive deep into the technical design, identify trade-offs (both back end and front end), surface edge cases, drive decision making, influence, and drive long-term product roadmap and success. The role will also suit someone who enjoys collaborating across our wider suite of products and capabilities to drive impact on high priority business needs.
You should be passionate about improving Amazon’s end-to-end processes and technology, and building partnerships across business and development teams to drive changes. You have the proven ability to dive deep into complex systems and metrics and understand the business context behind the data and technology, continuously striving to find deeper insights. You will be responsible for using innovative technology and seek out best practices.
This role will allow you to make a real impact on our business from Day 1, and provide a dynamic, innovative and fast-paced environment to constantly build your skill set and address new challenges.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the experience and product design for new feature launch and rollout in our product suite.
- Deeply understand user needs and effectively translate into structured product and technical requirements, regularly driving conversations with users and diving deep on their feedback to identify and prioritize high-impact improvements.
- Play a critical role in influencing the vision and product roadmap for the future, write effective PRFAQs and technical requirements, stay at the forefront of technology advancements and push the tech frontier.
- Understand complex business problems across business units, geographies and product lines.
- Manage ambiguity and translate this into tech requirements.
- Effectively partner with users in our team to solve their problems.
- Build strong relations with internal stakeholders to understand priorities, provide inputs to our roadmap and to collaborate and work with them on studies and actions to implement product and service solutions.
- Support hiring and onboarding of new team members and contribute to our high performing culture.
- Work cross functionally with peers/colleagues globally to support best practices, and shared opportunities.
About the team
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings - for almost every business at Amazon - for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, streamers, gamers). Our team is truly international, with members located in multiple countries around the world, enabling us to bring a global perspective to our work.
Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds, including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Solution Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers and more.

Amazon Pay's vision is to be the most trusted, convenient and rewarding payment experience preferred by millions of customers to pay in a wide range of use cases and contexts.
As part of this vision, we are embarking on a journey to build the largest Rewards program in India which is delightful for the customers and helps build loyalty towards Amazon Pay. A world-class rewards program requires a world-class funder experience — the ability to set up campaigns intelligently, measure ROI precisely, and enable any type of funder to easily use it. 
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end funder experience for Amazon Pay Rewards. In this role, you will reimagine the Rewards Console as a GenAI-forward platform that enables intelligent, hands-off campaign setup across discounts and Cashbacks; build the measurement infrastructure that proves the ROI of every rupee invested; and architect the path to externalize the platform for brands and funders at scale.

amazon:10574462.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Prime Video Commerce
amazon:10574462.desc:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
Want to change the way people stream movies and TV? We are seeking an experienced product manager to lead our efforts in building new and innovative experiences in how customers can access more content in the Prime Video app via 3rd party subscription plans. 
As a Senior Product Manager Technical, you will help define and build the roadmap and customer experience for Prime subscriptions and new 3rd party subscription plans in the Prime Video app across clients and geographies. You will participate in developing the strategy and vision, and develop product roadmaps to execute on that vision. This role is inherently cross-functional; you will work closely with engineering, project management, design, operations, finance, legal, business development, customer service, content acquisition, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our customer experience. 
We are looking for someone with experience in building digital subscription products and who is highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and has the ability to work independently to meet deadlines. You will also have a consistent track record in taking on end-to-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment.
Key job responsibilities
- Develop a deep understanding of the Prime Video customer, both existing and potential.

amazon:10577301.title: Product Manager Business Bulk Fulfilment, Amazon Business Operations - Analytics and Tech
amazon:10577301.desc:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.
Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.
A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.
About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Technical to join the MCCF team and lead product strategy and delivery for the UK and EU. MCF operates in the US, Canada, the UK, EU27, and Japan, with a growing presence in markets such as Mexico and Australia. International markets, led by the UK, EU, and Japan, are growing faster than the US. In this role, you will be responsible primarily for optimizing fulfillment and placement. Fulfillment covers how an order is promised, assigned to a fulfillment center, and delivered. Placement covers where inventory is positioned in the network ahead of demand. You will own the operational reliability and cost reduction goals for MCF's international markets, both of which are tracked as VP-level goals. You will define the international product roadmap, determine which problems MCCF addresses first in these markets, and lead the most complex initiatives directly.
Amazon's Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), enables every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. With ASCS, merchants can take advantage of fully automated supply chain services that get products from manufacturers to customers around the world, through end-to-end solutions including Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy With Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD), Warehousing & Logistics, and more. These services keep products in stock, deliver faster and more reliable shipping, and significantly lower costs. For over 20 years, Amazon has been empowering small and medium-sized businesses with opportunities to grow. ASCS and MCCF are an exciting next step in our mission to help merchants of all sizes grow their business, whether on Amazon or beyond.
The MCCF product organization is primarily based in the US. Initiatives that extend an existing US product to international markets remain with the US product owner. This role owns initiatives that are specific to international markets, such as enabling off-Amazon merchants to place a single inventory pool across EU27 countries, and initiatives whose scale or complexity exceeds what the US team can take on alongside its own roadmap. You will set the prioritization of international work across the MCCF product organization and partner with US product leaders to align roadmaps.
Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the international product roadmap for MCF fulfillment and placement in the UK and EU, including the rationale for sequencing and investment.
- Own the cost reduction goal for international markets, tracked at VP level. MCF must lower its cost per unit every year through 2029. Placement is the primary lever. Inventory positioned in the region where the order ships costs less to deliver and arrives sooner.
- Own the operational reliability goal for international markets, tracked at VP level. Marketplaces set shipping and delivery SLAs, and merchants incur penalties when MCF misses them.
- Lead the international initiatives that are specific to the region or exceed the US team's capacity, from problem definition through launch and adoption.
- Determine, together with US product leaders, which initiatives extend from the US and which the international team owns, and ensure international requirements are reflected in US roadmaps.
- Partner with the engineering teams that own placement, forecasting, promise, and fulfillment planning systems. Evaluate design proposals, assess trade-offs, and identify when a decision requires principal engineer review.
- Author the documents that drive decisions, including PR-FAQs, strategy narratives, and annual planning inputs for international markets. Present regularly to Directors and VPs.
- Evaluate new international opportunities, such as cross-border fulfillment, and bring recommendations to leadership.

 The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.
 Asana is building its next major business line: Service Management, powered by AI agents and tightly integrated with Asana’s Work Graph. This is a 0→1 opportunity to define how IT, HR, and Support teams resolve work, automate workflows, and connect tickets to projects in a modern, AI-native platform. We’re looking for a hands-on, highly entrepreneurial Lead PM who combines deep product craft with customer obsession, technical fluency, and strong go-to-market instincts. This person will help incubate a new business from scratch, partner directly with customers, and drive the product and GTM strategy required to build the next scalable product at Asana. 
 This role is ideal for someone who loves ambiguity, builds quickly, learns from customers, and has experience shaping AI agentic workflows, IT/service automation tools, or adjacent enterprise SaaS products.
 This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
 What you’ll achieve 
 Drive the 0→1 strategy and product vision by helping define the 3-year product strategy for Asana’s ESM business, including differentiation through AI agents, automations, and deep workflow integrations, and establishing Asana’s “right to win.
 Partner deeply with customers by spending significant time validating pain points, co-developing workflows, and translating insights into clear MVP scope, an iterative roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
 Build and launch an AI-native MVP, prioritizing a focused set of capabilities that solve real customer problems and collaborating closely with engineering, design, and UXR to build reliable, technical AI systems.
 Drive cross-functional GTM by partnering with Sales, Channel, PMM, and CS on positioning, pricing, packaging, early lighthouse accounts, and working with channel partners to refine migration and onboarding experiences.
 Operate with startup-level hustle and high velocity, breaking down ambiguous problems, shipping iteratively, validating quickly, learning from real usage, and staying scrappy and passionate about the 0→1 stage.

 10+ years of Product Management experience , with demonstrated success building AI-driven platforms, automation systems, service workflows, or enterprise SaaS products; experience with multi-agent systems, LLM-powered workflows, or AI operations is a plus.
 Strong 0→1 builder — you’ve built and scaled new products or incubations before and operate with urgency, resourcefulness, and creativity, pushing through ambiguity.
 Technical systems thinker , comfortable going deep on architecture, flows, and tradeoffs with engineering, and able to reason about integrations, identity systems, workflow engines, and AI agent behavior.

asana:8260059.title: Lead Product Manager, APIs and MCP
asana:8260059.desc:
The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs into products that help teams work together and see the larger purpose behind their work. As AI agents become part of how work gets done, we’re building new ways for people, developers, and agents to collaborate through Asana’s Work Graph.
 We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead product strategy for Asana’s APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. You’ll help external developers and AI agents understand and act on the work teams manage in Asana—from tasks and projects to the goals, ownership, and dependencies that connect them. You’ll shape a platform that makes these workflows useful, reliable, and secure, balancing developer experience with the controls enterprise customers need. You’re a technical product leader who can reason deeply about systems, turn emerging customer needs into a focused roadmap, and bring engineering, design, research, and go-to-market partners together to deliver meaningful outcomes.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
 What you’ll achieve 
 Own the product vision and prioritized roadmap for Asana’s APIs and MCP server, connecting developer and customer needs to Asana’s broader product strategy.
 Enable external developers and agents to complete valuable workflows in Asana, and improve the journey from discovering Asana's APIs and MCP tools to completing a first successful workflow.
 Expand access to Work Graph capabilities in partnership with the teams that own them.
 Reduce friction in documentation, authorization, and everyday use.
 Partner closely with engineering to improve platform reliability, performance, and compatibility as API and MCP capabilities evolve. 
 Use customer feedback, evaluations, and success measures (adoption, workflow completion, reliability, and time to value) to identify where workflows fail and prioritize improvements.
 Work with security and enterprise product teams to make agent access trustworthy. Define clear permissions, administrative controls, and accountability for actions taken by agents.
 Lead initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration across multiple teams. Measure success through adoption, workflow completion, reliability, and time to value.
 About you 
 6-8 years of product management experience, with a track record of launching and growing products in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or developer platforms.
 Experience shaping technical platform or developer-facing products, including APIs and MCP servers, and connecting API and infrastructure decisions to real customer problems and business outcomes.
 Technical fluency and systems thinking. You can reason about APIs, authentication, permissions, dependencies, and failure modes, and translate technical protocols into clear end-to-end user flows. You have experience designing API contracts, managing versioning and backward compatibility, and owning SDKs and developer documentation.
 Strong product judgment. You can navigate ambiguity, identify the core problem, and turn a broad opportunity into a focused, sequenced roadmap.
 A customer-centered, analytical approach. You seek out developer and user feedback, define meaningful success measures, and use evidence to guide prioritization and iteration.
 Proven ability to lead end-to-end product delivery and align multiple teams around difficult decisions. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners and keep execution moving across dependencies.
 Experience mentoring and developing other product managers.
 Preferred: bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
 What we’ll offer 
 Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
