 Elastic, the Search AI Company, is looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for the Elastic Agent Builder. As organizations shift from traditional data retrieval to autonomous, agentic workflows, the Agent Builder serves as the critical context layer that enables users to make Agents faster, lower cost, and more accurate. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for defining how enterprises build, manage, and scale context for AI agents. You will work at the cutting edge of the AI ecosystem, working with senior leadership and partnering with hyperscalers and evangelizing our solutions to a global community of AI developers.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Work directly with enterprise customers, sales teams, and solution architects to understand requirements, negotiate priorities, clarify product needs 
 Build, socialize and align a roadmap for core context engineering capabilities built on top of Elastic powered retrieval and relevance for AI Agents 
 Deeply understand the AI Agent market, major players, trends and how it may impact our strategy 
 Work directly data science and engineering to build out the strategy for benchmarking and evaluations of agent capabilities 
 Work with design to build user experiences that address gaps in how agents show and refine context as they work
 Be the product expert and evangelize capabilities for Agent Builder through content like blog posts and open source projects  
 Work with a broad ecosystem of AI partners including cloud service providers (Google, Amazon, Microsoft) and community developers 
 What You Bring 
 Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for technical, cloud infrastructure, or platform products. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.
 AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical understanding of the AI/ML landscape, including LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and context engineering. You are comfortable working closely with engineers and data scientists to solve intricate technical challenges.   
 Bias to action: You are able to move fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions. 
 Leadership and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

elastic:8332655.title: Principal Product Manager, Security Pricing and Packaging (Serverless) - Security Solutions
elastic:8332655.desc:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless. 
 More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence. 
 We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call. 
 The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team. 
 Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships. 
 Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue. 
 Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy. 
 Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it. 
 Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities. 
 Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit. 
 You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one. 
 What You Bring 
 You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex. 
 Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side. 
 You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator. 
 You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design. 
 You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes. 
 You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals as the product expert.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design.  - Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

 Expedia Group powers travel for everyone, everywhere. As AI becomes core to how travelers plan, book, and manage their trips, it is also changing how we build for them — and merchandising is where that change is furthest along. 
 The Merchandising Platform team owns the commercial layer of the traveler experience across every Expedia Group brand: price display, product badging, price insights, the algorithms that identify and rank collections, and the merchandising pages and services that power them. Today, brand teams operate this platform manually — designing individual experiments, configuring each change, and waiting weeks between an idea and a result. We are building the agentic systems that change that: autonomous agents that generate hypotheses, assemble experiences from configurable components, run experiments continuously within brand-defined guardrails, and roll out winners — with brand teams acting as strategists and governors rather than operators. 
 In this role, you will be a hands-on AI builder PM at the centre of that shift. You will prototype and ship multi-agent systems that automate the merchandising experiment lifecycle end to end, define the trust and governance patterns that let agents act safely on live traveler experiences, and lead the most promising capabilities from experiment to production at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands — and set the pattern for how autonomous optimisation expands across the rest of the traveler journey. 
 In this Role, you will: 
 Own the product direction for autonomous merchandising optimisation — from agent-assisted experiment setup today to agents that generate, launch, evaluate, and roll out tests continuously within brand-defined success metrics, guardrails, and policies.

 Take successful prototypes to production with engineering, data science, and design — including human review gates, guardrail breach detection, automated rollback, audit trails, and attribution so every agent action is measurable and reversible. 
 Define the trust architecture for agents acting on live experiences: preview/approve/undo flows, escalation triggers, explainability, and override tracking — patterns designed to be adopted by teams across Expedia Group as autonomous optimisation expands to new surfaces. 
 Drive measurable outcomes: compress experiment cycle time from months to days, multiply experiment throughput per surface, and demonstrate conversion and revenue lift from agent-optimised merchandising — without degrading traveler trust or experience quality. 
 Partner closely with experimentation, content and configuration platforms, GenAI platform, and brand product teams across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo to make agent capabilities work end to end across the organisation. 
 Evaluate emerging capabilities from frontier labs and internal platforms — tool use, multi-agent orchestration, agent memory, evaluation techniques — and translate them into concrete product concepts and working demos. 
 Lead the organisational shift alongside the technical one: build brand teams' trust in agent-operated optimisation, define how they set strategy and guardrails rather than individual tests, and share playbooks so agentic operation becomes how merchandising works across Expedia Group.

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
 About the Team & Role 
Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
 What You’ll Do 
 Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions. 
 Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context. 
 Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery. 
 Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners. 
 Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout. 
 Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status. 
 Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact. 
 Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders. 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products. 
 Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery. 
 Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research. 
 Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.

genesys:JR112386.title: Technical Product Manager – Platform Engineering
genesys:JR112386.desc:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 
 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 
 Job Title: Technical Product Manager – Platform Engineering
 Department & Team: Platform Engineering
 Reports to: Principal Product Manager
 Location: Remote
 Summary 
 We are seeking a Technical Product Manager – Platform Engineering to help define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of DevOps capabilities that enable engineering teams to build, test, deploy, operate, and secure cloud software at scale.
 This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Experience, Security, and Site Reliability Engineering . You will partner closely with engineering teams, architects, SRE, Security, and Product stakeholders to identify high-value platform opportunities, translate complex technical problems into clear product requirements, and prioritize investments that improve developer productivity, operational efficiency, reliability, security, and governance.
 Our developers and engineering teams are the customers of our platform. This role will apply a platform-as-a-product mindset —using customer discovery, data, adoption, and measurable outcomes to identify developer friction and create reusable, self-service capabilities that make the right way the easiest way.
 This is an opportunity to influence how software is developed and delivered at scale while helping shape the next generation of our internal developer platform. The role will also help identify opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to reduce developer and operational toil throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Key Responsibilities 
 The primary responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to:
 Define product strategy and roadmap: Partner with Platform Engineering leadership, engineering teams, architects, and internal customers to translate organizational objectives and developer needs into clear product strategies, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
 Treat the platform as a product: Develop a deep understanding of developers as customers through product discovery, feedback, usage data, and engineering metrics. Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and prioritize platform capabilities that improve developer experience and productivity.
 Own product priorities and backlog: Translate product strategy into prioritized initiatives, epics, features, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures. Maintain a healthy backlog that balances customer value, engineering capacity, technical debt, reliability, security, compliance, and strategic investment.
 Drive platform self-service and standardization: Identify opportunities to replace repetitive or manually operated processes with reusable platform capabilities, APIs, automation, templates, and paved-road experiences that increase developer autonomy while maintaining appropriate enterprise guardrails.
 Partner with engineering through delivery: Work closely with engineering and technical leaders on planning, refinement, sequencing, dependencies, risks, and delivery. Participate actively in Agile planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives while partnering with engineering leadership on team execution and Agile operating practices.
 Drive cross-team execution: Identify and manage dependencies, risks, sequencing requirements, and resource constraints across DevOps, Development, SRE, Security, Architecture, and other teams required to deliver platform capabilities.
 Measure outcomes, not just delivery: Establish product success metrics and evaluate capabilities based on adoption and measurable outcomes such as developer experience, toil reduction, cycle time, reliability, operational efficiency, security, and cost—not simply whether functionality was delivered.
 Apply technical product leadership: Develop sufficient understanding of CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, APIs, software delivery, observability, reliability, and related technologies to engage effectively with engineers and architects, understand technical tradeoffs, and translate technical capabilities into customer and business value.
 Identify AI and automation opportunities: Evaluate opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation across software development and platform operations, including areas such as vulnerability remediation, version migrations, CI/CD troubleshooting, deployment analysis, observability, and repet

genesys:JR112388.title: Director, Product Management – Agentic Orchestration
genesys:JR112388.desc:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 
 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 
 Location: This role offers the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Ireland. Given the highly collaborative nature of the position, regular visits to our state-of-the-art Genesys office in the heart of Galway City will be an important part of staying connected and working closely with key partners and teams.
 Genesys is building Agentic Orchestration: a new orchestration layer in Genesys Cloud that decides what a customer's journey needs next - across conversations, channels, and time, instead of resolving one interaction in isolation. The architecture is validated. What's ahead is turning it into a shipped, production capability used by real customers.
 Role Overview: 
 The Director of Product Management, Agentic Orchestration, owns that execution: the detailed product decisions that turn validated architecture into reality - what ships first, how tradeoffs get resolved as the system meets real engineering constraints, and how a broad set of product, engineering, and design partners stay aligned as it comes together. Success requires a leader who can go deep enough on technical detail to earn engineering's trust, and explain that same complexity clearly enough to keep leadership and cross-functional partners aligned.
 This is an individual-contributor position today, and it calls for proven leadership at a Director level - someone who has already led through ambiguity and cross-functional complexity without relying on formal authority. As the Agentic Orchestration team in Galway continues to grow, this role carries a clear path to people management for the right candidate.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Cross-Functional Leadership 
 You've led through complexity in a highly matrixed organization - setting direction and driving alignment across teams without relying on formal authority.
 You know how to partner with engineering, design, and adjacent product teams to keep a complex initiative moving forward.
 You've influenced roadmaps and priorities well beyond your direct ownership boundaries.
 You've brought a broad set of stakeholders, including teams you didn't lead directly, around a shared plan, and made it stick.
 You communicate execution status, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly enough to move senior leadership to a decision.
 Own Product Execution 
 You own the detailed product specification for orchestration capabilities as they move from validated architecture to shipped product.
 You make the sequencing and scope calls a complex, multi-system design demands as it meets engineering reality.
 You resolve ambiguous technical and product questions into buildable plans rather than deferring them.
 You've made high-stakes calls on a still-forming system, and stood behind them.
 Partner with Engineering 
 You work directly and continuously with engineering leadership to evaluate architecture and systems tradeoffs.
 You translate product requirements into specifications engineering can build against with confidence.
 You've helped establish product practices suited to building agentic, AI-driven systems.
 Deliver Measurable Outcomes 
 You define success measures for orchestration performance, journey resolution, and customer outcomes.
 You build telemetry and validation into major initiatives from the start, not after the fact.
 You evaluate the roadmap's real-world performance and adjust accordingly.
 Required Qualifications: 
 10+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS, AI-powered software, or complex distributed systems.
 Demonstrated experience taking a technically complex, multi-team product from architecture through to shipped, production use.
 Proven leadership track record at a Director level or equivalent - demonstrated success leading teams, projects, or initiatives, whether or not through formal management - with the readiness and interest to grow into people management as the team scales.
 High emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and teams you don't manage.
 Clear, direct communicator who drives a project forward and keeps stakeholders aligned.
 Skilled at navigating technical, business, and team-priority tradeoffs.
 Comfortable running workshops with a range of stakeholders - technical and non-technical, internal and executive.
 Strong technical background, evidenced by prior project experience with: 
 Event-driven / event-based architectures.
 Agentic systems

Who we are: 
 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 
 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 
 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description.  Who you are: 
 We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results ! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Manager who will oversee product development from conception to launch across multiple products or segments and discover, develop, and cultivate new products and ongoing product enhancements that support Geotab’s business models and continued growth . If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you ! 
 What you'll do: 
 As a Senior Product Manager your key area of responsibility will be understanding the infrastructure needed to support the growth of revenue streams, owning the comprehensive product roadmap, and driving portfolio-level prioritization aligned with overall business strategy . You will need to work closely with UX designers, developers, data scientists, technical project managers, customers, and senior leadership . To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter, resourceful, empathetic listener, and a strong team player with well-defined diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills . In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, strategic thinking, and experience leveraging user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive data-informed dec ision-making.

 Understand the infrastructure needed to support the growth of existing and new revenue streams within Geotab, the associated market, and how custo mers can benefit from telematics solutions to improve their business.

 Lead high-impact customer discovery initiatives and mentor other team members in conducting interviews to refine value propositions and product fit. 
 Drive prioritization at a portfolio lev el, aligning efforts with overall business and product strategy. 
 Establish advanced reporting and monitoring frameworks that measure success (both qualitative and quantitative) across multiple product dimensions. 
 Design and implement feedback loops at scale, ensuring continuous alignment with market needs. 
 Ensure company-wide unde rstanding of product efforts, regularly communicating the Why at senior leadership forums and cross-departmental meetings. 
 Lead complex problem and solution validation, ensuring strategic alignment and providing direction on critical solutions. 
 Oversee the translation of needs into detailed epics and initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall product strategy. 
 Work closely with technical project managers toward execution. 
 Collect and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders and internal teams to continuously make improvements to products that are launched. 
 Lead efforts to enhance product management frameworks, mentoring other product managers and contributing to company-wide initiatives. 
 What you'll bring to this role: 
 5 - 8 years of required experience in product management and/or customer discovery. 
 Bachelor’s degree or Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree (or equivalent work experience), with specialization in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field highly valued. 
 Demonstrated experience and strong understanding of user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive da

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 
 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 
 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description.  We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results ! If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you ! 
 What you'll do: 
 As a Senior Product Manager your key area of responsibility will be understanding the infrastructure needed to support the growth of revenue streams, owning the comprehensive product roadmap, and driving portfolio-level prioritization aligned with overall business strategy . Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 We're looking for an outstanding Lead Product Manager to join GetYourGuide's Paid Search team. In this role, you'll drive the vision, strategy, and growth of the products that power one of our largest customer acquisition channels.
 Paid Search at GetYourGuide sits at the intersection of back-end automation and data products. The tech powering the channel is no longer just a set of back-end systems — it's increasingly a portfolio of data products (signals, feeds, bidding inputs, attribution) consumed by our Marketing team and by adjacent Growth surfaces. Your job is to shape that portfolio: set the strategy, define the roadmap, and partner with engineering to ship it.
 You'll work closely with the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team, who are both your closest partners and your primary internal customers. If you want to shape the future of paid customer acquisition with us, read on.
 Your mission 
 Ownership : You are skilled at laying out your team's strategy, setting goals, and following through — owning the outcomes of your team's work end to end.
 Ambiguity: You can create meaning and value from ambiguity, and you're comfortable operating in a space where the "product" is often a system, a signal, or a model rather than a UI.
 Data product thinking: You treat internal capabilities — bidding inputs, feeds, signals, attribution — as products with consumers, contracts, and a roadmap, not as back-end plumbing. You define what "good" looks like for the teams that depend on them.
 Communication: You demonstrate a clear and structured approach to communicating; able to connect your team's strategy to the company's mission and break it down into clear next steps for engineers, marketers, and leadership alike.
 Prioritisation: You use your data skills and customer empathy to weigh competing initiatives, make clear decisions on priorities, and continually re-evaluate your roadmap based on what you learn.
 Collaboration: You build trust across a demanding set of stakeholders — the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team — keeping them aligned on a shared roadmap and clear expectations.
 Experimentation: You use experimentation to evaluate your team's investments, leveraging your data skills to interpret results and decide what to do next.
 Your toolkit 
 7+ years of professional experience in product management.
 Demonstrated experience building data products or ML-adjacent products — for example, feature stores, signal pipelines, ML platforms, bidding, pricing, ranking, or attribution systems. You can reason about model-driven products, feedback loops, and guardrails.
 Demonstrated ownership over a product in a previous role, including responsibilities for strategy, KPI setup, goal-setting, and roadmap.
 Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.
 Experience with experimentation as a core decision-making tool.
 Experience working with large Paid Search setups is a strong plus.
 Experience with Search Engine Optimization is a plus.
 Experience working on a SaaS product, a marketplace, or in the travel industry is a plus.

 Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

 And more…

 Team mission 
 Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.
 Your mission 
 As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.
 This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.
 We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.
 What You'll Do 
 Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.
 Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
 Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.
 Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.
 Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.
 Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.
 Your toolkit 
 6+ years of experience in product management , with a t least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.
 A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.
 Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.
 Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.
 Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.

getyourguide:8284800.title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
getyourguide:8284800.desc:
Change the way the world travels 
 GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.
 Team mission 
 GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.
 Your mission 
 As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.
 The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.
 We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.
 Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
 Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.
 Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.
 Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.
 Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.
 Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.
 Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products
 Your toolkit 
 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products
 Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery
 Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts
 A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs f

gocardless:8305788.title: Product Manager
gocardless:8305788.desc:
About us 
 GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless. 
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.
 The role 
 This role sits within the Merchant Risk Monitoring team in our Merchant Operations Group. The team is responsible for the core systems that manage our in-life merchant risk management. These systems ensure that we meet our compliance obligations and stay within our risk appetite as a business. 
 In this role, you will work closely with engineers to drive product improvements that strengthen our controls whilst continuing to provide a good customer experience. You will also collaborate with teams across the organisation to ensure our capabilities scale with the needs of both customers and the business.
 What excites you  
 Delivering customer and business value: Being relentlessly focused on understanding and solving the customer problems which result in them using GoCardless as much as they can.
 Problem discovery and prioritisation: Taking complex and ambiguous product problems and structuring these effectively. This includes clearly defining the problem space, the impact of the problem and your prioritisation process.
 Data-led decision-making: Using quantitative and qualitative evidence to support your decisions and opportunity identification.
 Contributing to Product Strategy: Identifying key customer segments, and our approach to meeting their needs over the longer term in ways that create value for them and GoCardless
 Influencing and communication: Building collaborative relationships with your team, stakeholders and executives to deliver change effectively across your remit. This includes growing to become the ‘go-to’ person for your product area; translating complex, technical problems into understandable concepts; and convincing stakeholders of the best approach using structured reasoning.
 Leadership: Setting direction and coordinating action across a range of teams and functions
 Shipping stuff: Working with your team to support changes to completion, delivering consistent positive impact across your product area. Being comfortable delivering a range of projects: from MVP experiments testing a hypothesis to a new feature.
 What excites us   
 Delivery of impact: You are focused on delivering business value through experimentation and have experience of doing that.
 Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills:  We want our Product Managers to have an outstanding ability to tackle valuable customer and business problems. At GoCardless we start by asking ‘why?’, and a data-led approach is central to how we run Product. You have a customer centric approach and are comfortable with qualitative and quantitative analysis.
 High agency:  We’re after people who aren’t afraid of a challenge and will take ownership of problems they come across and help to resolve them and adapt to a constantly changing environment.
 Collaborative leaders: Product roles bring responsibility without direct authority. We’re looking for leaders who can motivate and earn the trust of stakeholders and teams with a collaborative approach.
 We don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you’re excited by this role, we encourage you to apply.
 Base salary range: €4,400 - €6,600 monthly
 Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
 (some of) The good stuff 
 Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
 Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
 Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
 Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
 Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
 Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness

 About Product Management
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
 Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
 The role
 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.
 Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.
 Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.
 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 
 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
 Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
 Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
 Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
 Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

hellofresh:8025707.title: Senior Product Manager
hellofresh:8025707.desc:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.
 This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.
 What You Will Be Doing: 
 Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.
 Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.
 Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.
 Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.
 Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.
 People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.
 Who You Are: 
 Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.
 A genuine passion for food, with the ability to translate taste trends and market signals into compelling product offerings.
 Proven people leadership across different career stages - coaching, clear direction, and investment in growth.
 Strong commercial acumen - connecting product decisions to business outcomes including revenue and retention.
 Excellent cross-functional influence - aligning teams toward a shared goal without needing formal authority.
 Organised and structured, with strong project management skills and the ability to deliver to tight deadlines.
 Strong analytical skills - able to drill into detail, connect findings to the big picture, and present insights clearly.
 Customer-centric, with creative thinking to identify unmet needs and develop solutions that address them.
 A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.
 Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.
 At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.
 Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.
 Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
 What you will get in return: 
 The chance to have a serious impact on one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Europe in an exciting growth phase
 Direct, high impact on our Operations setup from day one
 A vibrant, international environment with mission-driven colleagues
 A guaranteed steep learning curve & boost for your career
 Benefit from our selection of employee perks (70% off your HelloFresh boxes, private health insurance, employer matching pension program, cycle to work scheme, Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme, gym membership etc.)
 Location : Dublin Docklands, Ireland
 To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in ROI, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time. 
 Hybrid Working Policy 
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies

hellofresh:8043204.title: Staff Product Manager, Benefits Platform (all genders)
hellofresh:8043204.desc:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.
 About the role: What's in the Box 
 As a Staff Product Manager, you will own and evolve HelloFresh's benefit creation platform, which defines, configures, and governs every discount, voucher, and reward across all our global brands and channels. Leading a dedicated squad of engineers, you will transform this high-impact system into a flexible, scalable, and highly automated platform. This is a foundational infrastructure role where you will design self-serve tooling and robust governance rules, ensuring our marketing and commercial teams can safely launch campaigns without engineering bottlenecks. Your work will directly protect our P&L margins while unlocking innovative, automated capabilities for future customer experiences.
 What you’ll do: The Recipe 
 Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for our global benefit and incentive platform, setting the path toward intelligent, automated creation tools.
 Design scalable platform primitives and reusable building blocks to eliminate custom, one-off engineering for individual marketing campaigns.
 Establish automated governance layers, including margin floors and stacking checks, to systematically protect business profitability.
 Build intuitive back-office tooling that enables commercial and growth teams to configure standard campaigns independently.
 Drive cross-functional alignment across international teams, encouraging adoption of a unified platform contract.
 Evaluate and implement automation and smart interfaces where they bring the highest return on investment, balancing flexibility with system reliability.
 What you’ll bring: The Ingredients  
 Extensive experience in platform product management is essential, with a proven track record of building scalable internal tools, APIs, or foundational infrastructure rather than just user-facing features.
 You bring 6+ years of product management experience, specifically operating already at a Senior or Staff level within complex systems across multiple markets or diverse business lines.
 Exceptional leadership and communication skills are required to align senior, cross-functional stakeholders and champion platform adoption without direct authority.
 It is a strong advantage if you bring a background in commercial strategy or promotional economics, enabling you to design smart business guardrails that balance marketing flexibility with P&L protection.
 Familiarity with data analysis and technical architecture is highly valued, helping you effectively design reliable automation and interpret experiment data alongside engineering teams.
 Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
 What we offer: The Toppings 
 Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
 Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
 Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
 End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.
 Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point (Prosta 20). The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).
 Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.  We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

hellofresh:8095957.title: Senior Product Manager, Intelligent Platforms
hellofresh:8095957.desc:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.
 Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.
 HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.
 About the role: What's in the Box 
 The Foundations Alliance's mission is to accelerate the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and highly available digital products at HelloFresh by providing services and platforms that improve internal builder productivity and system reliability. This position is for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the Operational Data Platform—the systems that create, transport, and store data at the point of origin, making it available for downstream analytics or AI. The role holds accountability for a high-leverage layer of the data ecosystem: the streaming and database infrastructure that product engineering teams rely on to get data flowing reliably.
The core objective is to ensure operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with explicit quality guarantees. The service provider will define the roadmap for the squad's platform (event streaming, relational, and NoSQL databases), partner closely with the Engineering Lead for the Operational Data Platform, and collaborate cross-functionally with data producer and analytical teams. This engagement comes at a key moment for critical-path cost-efficiency and reliability initiatives. This role does not include people management responsibilities.
 At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.
 What you’ll do: The Recipe 
 Drive the product vision and roadmap for the Operational Data Platform—focusing on low-latency data creation, transport, storage, and availability for downstream analytics—partnering closely with the Engineering Lead for the platform.
 Lead the squad's cost-efficiency roadmap , taking accountability for targeted cost savings as a core KPI.
 Maintain the reliability of critical-path systems (streaming and core databases), setting uptime targets and feeding incident learnings back into platform planning.
 Champion data-contract and schema standards at the point of data creation, collaborating with data-producing engineering teams to close adoption gaps and ensure quality data flows downstream.
 Guide platform tooling decisions , consolidating technologies around optimal solutions rather than accumulating redundant options.
 Define and maintain the handover contract with the Analytical Data Platform, ensuring downstream data is consistently trustworthy and ready for governance.
 Act as the primary interface between the Operational Data Platform and data producers, translating business and technical needs into actionable roadmap priorities.
 Define, track, and report squad KPIs (cost efficiency, critical-path reliability, data-quality adoption) against quarterly alliance goals.
 What you’ll bring: The Ingredients  
 Proven experience as a Product Manager with a solid grounding in data infrastructure, data engineering, or backend platforms—comfortable with streaming, messaging, and database architecture.
 Working familiarity with event streaming and relational/NoSQL database technologies to partner credibly with engineering leads on technical trade-offs.
 Track record of driving roadmaps and KPIs for technical teams in platform problem spaces, managing metrics like cost, reliability, or data quality to target.
 Data-driven approach to prioritization and roadmap decisions, supported by analytical tools and frameworks.
 Strong collaboration and communication capabilities to establish trust and technical alignment with engineering leads and key stakeholders.
 Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset to drive day-to-day delivery autonomously and navigate cost, reliability, and technic

jetbrains:4782168101.desc:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.
 ThinkRail is an innovative project within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. Its aim is to develop a declarative programming language tailored to AI-spec-driven development. Our goal is to build an infrastructure that enables the efficient creation of complex systems with AI, while maintaining the trust of users and flexibility in the results.
 Thinkrail ( GitHub , Blog, Website ) is now open source and in alpha, and we’re entering the next stage of the product’s development: initial market penetration. We’re focused on bringing it into real-world projects and turning it into a robust, production-ready system. To help us get there, we’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to join the team. You’d be joining at an early stage, with plenty of opportunity to influence the product as it continues to evolve.
 About the role 
 We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence/Product Lead to work alongside the technical founder and own the product strategy for Thinkrail.
 This is not a traditional product management role. Your focus will be on deeply understanding real developer workflows: where specs, architecture, and code break down, what causes friction, and what problems are actually worth solving. You will translate these insights into concrete product requirements and priorities.
 In this role, you will: 
 Own the product strategy: Define the direction, validate key hypotheses, and decide what to build first.
 Run continuous discovery: Talk to developers and customers to understand real workflows, pain points, and opportunities.
 Define the initial scope: Identify the ICP, core use cases, and priorities for zero-to-one development.
 Shape GTM: Help define positioning, messaging, launch, and go-to-market strategy.
 Track the ecosystem: Stay close to competitors, adjacent tools, AI developments, and market trends
 Work closely with engineering: Keep a small team focused, aligned, and moving quickly in a highly ambiguous environment
 We will be happy to have you on our team if you have:
 8+ years of product management experience with end-to-end ownership of strategy, discovery, and delivery
 Startup experience is a must, ideally in a small team, with a strong track record of building and shipping zero-to-one
 Experience with developer tools or AI products is required
 High autonomy, speed, and comfort making decisions with limited information
 Strong technical fluency and the ability to work closely with engineers. Coding experience is a plus
 Founder, co-founder, C-level, or similar experience is a strong advantage
 Experience with GTM, marketing, launches, developer advocacy, or public speaking is also a plus
 Why join Project Thinkrail? 
 Foundational work: Help define a new direction in developer tooling at the intersection of programming languages and AI.
 Deep technical problems: Work on language design, formal specs, tooling, and AI agents – not surface-level features.
 Real ownership: Own the product’s strategy and direction, working in a role closer to that of a founder than a classic PM.
 JetBrains environment: Enjoy startup-level autonomy with JetBrains’ engineering culture and long-term mindset.
 #LI-YY1

jetbrains:4973134101.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Prague, Czech Republic; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
jetbrains:4973134101.desc:
Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.
 About JetBrains 
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
 What you’ll do 
 As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.
 This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.
 Day to day, you will:
 Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.
 Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
 Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
 Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
 Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
 Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
 Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
 Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.
 What you’ll bring 
 A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
 Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
 The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
 Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
 A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
 Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.
 What you’ll need 
 Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
 Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
 The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
 The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
 Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
 Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.
 What success looks like 
 Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.
 Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.
Why join JetBrains?  
 Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
 Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
 Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year worki
