jetbrains:5005323101.desc:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?
 About JetBrains 
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
 What you’ll do 
 Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 
 JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.
 Day to day, you will:
 Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
 Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
 Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
 Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
 Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
 Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
 Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
 Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.
 What you’ll bring 
 A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
 A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
 Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
 Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
 Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
 Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.
 What you’ll need 
 Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
 Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
 A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
 An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
 The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
 Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
 What success looks like 
 In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:
 Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
 Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
 Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
 Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
 Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
 About The Role
 The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
We're looking for a Head of Product to rethink our products and fraud systems to be AI-centric. You'll leverage AI for automation and enable intuitive, multi-modal customer interactions to build trust and streamline compliance processes.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Leading a financial crime product team, designing features that improve security across Revolut’s global platform
 Building teams to align with product objectives and developing team members to enable their career growth
 Overseeing your team's product roadmap, from strategic planning and conception, to execution and launch.
 What You'll Need
 7+ years of product management experience
 3+ years of experience managing large teams (product leaders at Revolut directly manage multiple squads and Product Owners)
 Experience managing AI products, data science products, customer-facing products, and back office systems
 Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
 High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
 A bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on
 Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
 The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

 7+ years of product management experience
 3+ years of experience managing large teams (product leaders at Revolut directly manage multiple squads and Product Owners)

 Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
 High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
 A bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on
 Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
 The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

linkedin:4440555733.desc:
Cleaned Document
 About The Role And Team
 Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information-and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you won't just manage a roadmap; you will build 0-to-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You'll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact-this is where you'll grow.
 What You'll Do
 Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber's global growth. 
 Design and ship scalable technology solutions-including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools-to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals. 
 Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities. 
 Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes. 
 Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations. 
 Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability. 
 Basic Qualifications 
 6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact. 
 Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects. 
 Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams. 
 Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery. 
 Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization. 
 Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts. 
 Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support. 
 Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics. 
 Passionate about shipping "magical," defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes. 
 Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops. 
 Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions. 
 Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts. 
 Ready to Ride?
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

linkedin:4452234556.desc:
Millions of people want to grow their money but don't know where to start. More than 90% of adults don't access traditional financial advice. That's the gap Plum was built to close.
 We're building the proactive money platform that makes it easy for people to smartly and sustainably grow their money. Whether you're stashing the cash for tea and toast in your first home or catching some rays during retirement, we've got your back.
 Since 2016, millions of people across 10 European markets have set aside more than £10 billion with Plum. But what we're most excited about is what comes next and the opportunity for our people to help shape it.
 We're now going after something even bigger: the £2 trillion+ advised market in the UK and beyond, currently locked behind high fees and complexity. By combining AI-driven financial guidance with the products people actually need, we're building a solution for everyone, not just the wealthy few.
 At Plum, you'll be part of a team that's ambitious, curious and driven. We move fast, learn from what doesn't work, challenge the status quo and, most importantly, build something that makes people's lives better. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and that the best work happens when people feel trusted to take ownership, collaborate openly and bring their whole selves to work.
 Join nearly 300 Plumsters and be part of a team shaping the future of money
 The Role
 Cash Products is one of Plum's most strategically important areas, sitting at the intersection of regulated financial products and customer growth. The domain spans Tax Wrappers (LISA, CISA) and Savings (Easy Access, Notice Accounts), serving customers who trust us with their most meaningful financial goals.
 We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to own this domain end-to-end. This is a senior individual contributor role with large scope: you'll develop novel approaches to long-standing problems, set the bar for craft and rigour across Cash Products, and deliver high-impact outcomes without needing a management layer between you and the work.
 Requirements
 What You Will Do
 Own the Cash Products domain across Tax Wrappers and Savings, including strategy, roadmap, and execution across two squads
 Build prioritisation frameworks grounded in company goals, commercial logic, and user motivation, and defend them clearly to stakeholders
 Work with design end to end, including content, IA, and interaction, and collab closely with designers to raise the quality bar, not just ship features
 Partner with engineering on scoping, sizing, and scope hammering, making sharp trade-offs that preserve outcome without ballooning build time
 Coordinate launches across the wider org, including marketing, compliance, CX, and ops, owning the go-to-market as much as the product
 Set the standard for how product is done in Cash Products: from how we run discovery to how we write specs to how we measure success
 Work with Compliance and Risk to navigate regulations and ISA/HMRC rules as a product constraint, not a blocker
 Partner with Finance and Commercial to define competitive rate structures, understand distribution economics, and build the business logic behind product bets
 Identify opportunities to improve how the squads work: refine discovery processes, sharpen rituals, and fix workflows that slow the team down
 Coach and support the squad PMs, helping them grow in their roles through feedback, shared context, and raising the quality bar together
 Work at the group level to create synergies between Tax Wrappers and Savings: surface cross-squad opportunities, align roadmaps where it matters, and avoid duplicated effort
 Drive features and ideas that help users build better financial habits: automated deposits, goal-based recommendations, and journeys that turn single-product users into multi-product users
 Who You Are
 7+ years in product management, with significant time in financial services or another regulated, trust-sensitive space
 A strong researcher and synthesiser: you can turn qualitative signals, quantitative data, and regulatory context into a clear point of view and a prioritised list
 Deep commercial acumen: understands how rates are set and calculated, how savings distribution works, what drives competitive positioning, and how to make a financial case for a product decision
 Fluent in ISA and savings mechanics, AER vs gross rate distinctions, and the commercial logic of cash products (or able to get there fast)
 Deeply hands-on: you write the brief, sit in the design critique, join the engineering refinement, and draft the launch comms yourself
 Sharp on business logic: you can build the financial case for a feature, stress-test assumptions, and walk a stakeholder through the numbers without blinking
 Experimental by instinct: you default to hypothesis-driven approaches, design tests before you design solutions, and iterate based on evidence

linkedin:4455223391.title: Senior Product Manager - Self service cloud
linkedin:4455223391.desc:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role:
 The Product Manager will lead critical areas within self-service cloud growth, empowering self-service customers and trial users to be successful. This role specifically focuses on human user onboarding and agents onboarding, directly influencing the successful growth of Elastic Cloud.
 What You Will Be Doing:
 Define the vision and roadmap for self service cloud growth, encompassing: onboarding and trial experience, product features adoption and trial activation, customer interviews and churn analysis, product engagement analytics and email nurturing.
 Partnering with engineering leads to prioritizing technical investments and establishing realistic delivery timelines.
 Collaborate with downstream Elastic solution teams (Observability, Security, Enterprise Search) to understand their specific onboarding flows and trial experience.
 Drive technical decision-making regarding onboarding, activation, expansion and retention of self-service customers.
 Interface with customers and trial users to gather feedback on trial experience.
 Collaborate with Sales & Marketing on competitive positioning and brand awareness.
 Drive native integrations with 3rd party developers platforms.
 What You Bring:
 4+ years of Product Management experience with deep technical products.
 Strong background and experience with Product Led Growth.
 Demonstrated experience with self-service cloud services, having shipped products that provide self-service trials.
 Data-driven approach to product decisions, with experience in product adoption and analysis.
 Strong communication skills, capable of cross function collaborations and alignment.
 Experience with globally distributed teams and asynchronous collaboration.
 Bonus Points:
 Direct experience with Elasticsearch or similar search/database technologies.
 Background in product marketing.
 Experience with cloud service providers marketplaces.
 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
 Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
 Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
 Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
 Generous number of vacation days each year
 Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
 Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
 Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
 Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to you

Company Description
 Who We Are
 Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 130 countries.
At Cint, we are committed to innovation and are rapidly expanding our portfolio of data solutions to power the next generation of insights. We are looking for passionate, results-oriented leaders to join us on this journey.
 Job Description
 The Role
 Join our Product Team as a Senior Product Manager. You’ll craft the strategic roadmap and steer the delivery of our Demand services. This role, based in the EU/UK, requires collaboration with our US teams during CET hours and can be remote or attached to one of our existing engineering offices.
 We're on the hunt for skilled product managers who have a unique blend of deep technical understanding, customer obsession and a love for solving product problems. With countless potential features to bring to life in Cint, seize the opportunity to be the decision-maker on one of the most impactful domains within Cint. 
 What You Will Do
 Own the Vision: Develop and promote a product vision for your part of Cint’s Exchange. We make long term investments with large payoffs for success, see the future and articulate it.
 Tell the Story: Masterfully articulate the "why" behind your product strategy. Bring complex customer and technical problems to life, inspiring and aligning senior leadership and the broader organization around your vision.
 Execute with Excellence: Conduct thorough opportunity assessments, backed by data and customer research, to validate assumptions and prioritize initiatives. Author clear, comprehensive product requirements and partner with R&D leadership to navigate complex technical trade-offs.
 Partner to Win: Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across R&D, Data Science, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Marketing to ensure cross-functional alignment and a successful go-to-market.
 Qualifications
 What We Are Looking For
 Proven Product Operator: You have a proven track record of launching, operating and scaling complex products, platforms, or services from concept to market or transforming existing products for their next stage of growth.
 Customer-Obsessed: You are an expert in translating customer problems from the ResTech and data space into clear, well-structured product requirements, backed by data and qualitative insights.
 Technical Expertise: You have direct experience managing the full lifecycle of API and UI driven products and can also clearly demonstrate shipping high quality experiences. Demonstrated knowledge, experience and interest in how LLMs and modern coding stacks challenge long held verities would be a strong plus.
 Exceptional Communicator: You possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills and are seen as an expert storyteller. You can effectively partner with senior leadership and are skilled at managing complex stakeholder maps.
 Remote First: Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment.
 Why Join Us?
 Strategic Impact: You will be driving the foundation of Cint's current and future success.
 Innovation: You will be on the cutting edge of ResTech and data technology, solving novel problems with a world-class R&D team.
 Global Reach: Cint is a global company with a distributed, flexible, and collaborative culture.
 Ownership: We empower our product team. You will have the autonomy and accountability to make a measurable impact on the business.
 Additional Information
 Our Values
 Collaboration is our superpower
 We uncover rich perspectives across the world
 Success happens together
 We deliver across borders.
 Innovation is in our blood
 We’re pioneers in our industry
 Our curiosity is insatiable
 We bring the best ideas to life.
 We Do What We Say
 We’re accountable for our work and actions
 Excellence comes as standard
 We’re open, honest and kind, always.
 We are caring
 We learn from each other’s experiences
 Stop and listen; every opinion matters
 We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.
 More About Cint
 We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.
Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stock

Introduction
 At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 About the Role:
 Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.
This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.
Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.
 What You Will Do
 Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.
 Define the future of real-time stream sharing across organizations, including its security model, networking, access controls, and how it scales across organizations and use cases.
 Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.
 Segment and re-package Cluster Linking. The product serves Disaster Recovery, migrations, data sharing, and cross-cloud replication, each with different customer needs and pricing dynamics. Define how we package, price, and position each so the offering works for customers and drives growth.
 Partner closely with your engineering manager counterpart as a strategic partner. Use that partnership to understand tradeoffs, make decisions fast, and keep the product moving forward.
 Work directly with customers. You'll be pulled in many directions, customers will ask a lot of you. Your job is to steer them toward the right architectures and models, get them excited about what's coming, listen to what they need next, and balance the present opportunity with where the product is headed.
 Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.
 Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in infrastructure, data platforms, or cloud products. You've shipped technical products and driven measurable outcomes.
 Genuine interest in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. Kafka is not simple. You don't need prior Kafka expertise, but you need to be energized by technical depth, not put off by it.
 A results-driven mindset. You don't wait for things to happen, you make them happen. You get on calls with sellers, you pull in the right people, and you keep pushing until the work is done.
 Proven ability to influence. You get people excited and aligned, across engineering, field, sales, finance, and leadership, often without formal authority.
 Strong ownership mentality. You take responsibility from day one. You drive ambiguous problems to clarity, remove blockers, and treat the product like your own business.
 Business thinking beyond the backlog. You think about segmentation, packaging, pricing, and market impact, not just features. You understand that how a product is offered matters as much as what it does.
 Clear communication. You can make technical topics understandable for executive audiences, write sharp product docs, and present confidently to customers and leadership.
 LLM or GenAI knowledge is a bonus, but not required

 Expertise in Market Analysis: Experience

 Part of something bigger
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.
 Your Hiring Experience Matters
 Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.
The Netherlands Payroll product at Shine
Our Netherlands payroll product, today offered as Employes by Shine, is a SaaS solution that helps Dutch companies run accurate, compliant payroll and manage core employee data in one place. It operates in a complex, business‑critical, regulation‑heavy domain where reliability and correctness matter every single month. The product is established and growing with an existing customer base and a full roadmap of improvements and new capabilities.
This role is an opportunity to take real ownership of that product while still having significant freedom to shape where it goes next. Payroll is inherently complex, and your goal is to make something complicated feel remarkably simple for customers. You will work with a strong, complete cross‑functional team — five engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Designer and a Payroll Expert — and have direct access to customers, business stakeholders and leadership. At the same time, the journey goes beyond optimising an existing product: Employes is becoming part of the broader Shine Payroll proposition, creating opportunities to rethink the product, expand its addressable market and build capabilities that can scale beyond the Netherlands. It is a role with significant autonomy, visible business impact and plenty of complex product problems still left to solve.
Your role as a Senior Product Manager, Netherlands Payroll
As Senior Product Manager for our Netherlands payroll product, you take end‑to‑end ownership of the strategy and roadmap and steer where the product goes next. You translate company and Payroll Tribe strategy into clear priorities and trade‑offs for the team, and work closely with Engineering, Design and our Payroll Expert to turn complex, compliance‑heavy requirements into simple, scalable product solutions. You ensure we continue to serve existing customers exceptionally well, while evolving the product as part of Shine Payroll and unlocking new growth opportunities beyond the Netherlands.
Your responsibilities will include
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for our Netherlands payroll product, translating company and Payroll Tribe strategy into clear priorities and trade‑offs for the team.
 Lead product discovery to identify the highest‑impact customer and business problems, and work closely with Engineering, Design and our Payroll Expert to turn complex payroll requirements into simple, scalable product solutions.
 Drive product initiatives end‑to‑end — from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption and measurement of impact — using customer insights, product data and commercial performance to inform decisions.
 Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure strong alignment between product development and market needs, and to support successful launches and adoption in the market.
 Contribute to broader Payroll Tribe initiatives, including the transition towards Shine Payroll and opportunities to reuse capabilities across markets and products.
 📍 Job located in Amsterdam, Netherlands with possibility of two remote working days per week.
 About You
 You bring strong Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of owning a product roadmap and driving discovery and delivery end‑to‑end.
 You have strong technical affinity and enjoy working closely with engineers on complex, rules‑based or integration‑heavy products; experience in payroll, HRTech, FinTech or another regulated/compliance‑heavy domain is a strong plus.
 You are data‑driven and outcome‑focused: you combine qualitative customer insights, product analytics and commercial performance to shape priorities

 The Role
 As Senior Product Manager – Integrations & Data Connectivity, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Enablon's integration platform. You will drive the evolution of our connectivity capabilities, enabling customers, partners, and internal teams to exchange data more efficiently, securely, and at scale.
Working at the intersection of product, technology, and customer needs, you'll help define the future of data connectivity within Enablon while delivering measurable business value and customer outcomes.
 What Will You Do?

Working closely with Engineering, customers, and partners, you'll define the vision, set the roadmap, and deliver scalable integration solutions that make data connectivity simpler, faster, and more self-service.
 In this role, you will:
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Integrations & Data Connectivity.
 Drive the evolution of our integration platform and connector ecosystem.
 Translate customer and stakeholder needs into scalable product capabilities.
 Partner with Engineering to deliver innovative solutions and measurable outcomes.
 Drive adoption, value creation, and business impact across customers and internal teams.
 Your Skills And Profile
 You are a Product Manager who thrives on solving complex integration challenges and transforming them into scalable products that create real customer value. You enjoy working in highly technical environments, can engage confidently with engineers and architects, and know how to translate complexity into a clear product vision and roadmap.
At the same time, you're equally comfortable working with customers and business stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions that deliver measurable outcomes.
 We're particularly interested in candidates who have:
 Experience managing platform, integration, API, data, or enterprise SaaS products.
 A strong understanding of APIs, data connectivity, and enterprise integrations.
 The ability to work effectively with Engineering and technical stakeholders.
 Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
 Experience with iPaaS platforms such as Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic, or similar solutions.

 You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding complex challenges from both a technical and business perspective. You balance strategic thinking with pragmatism, remain effective in dynamic environments, and are motivated by delivering meaningful outcomes for customers.
 Why This Role at Enablon?

Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?
 About JetBrains
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
 What You’ll Do
 Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process.
JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.
 Day To Day, You Will
 Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
 Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
 Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
 Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
 Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
 Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
 Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
 Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.
 What You’ll Bring
 A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
 A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
 Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
 Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
 Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
 Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.
 What You’ll Need
 Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
 Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
 A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
 An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
 The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
 Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
 What Success Looks Like
 In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:
 Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
 Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
 Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
 Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
 Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.
 Why join JetBrains?
 Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
 Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
 Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
 Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

 Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
 Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

What We Do
 At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.
 What You'll Be Doing
 You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
 What We Are Looking For
 You might be a fit if:
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
 You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
 You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
 Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
 You're fluent in English; German is a plus
 You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

 Strong plus if you have:
 PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
 Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
 Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
 Subscription and paywall experimentation

 Build the future of physical products at Loop
 At Loop, we're building far more than iconic earwear. We're creating physical products that help people focus, sleep, recover, connect, and thrive.
As our Senior Product Manager, you'll take ownership of a next-generation physical product and help define what's next. You'll turn customer insights, market data, and technical trends into products people love, leading every phase from idea to in-market success while bringing teams together around a clear product vision.
Working across Design, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Commercial, you'll help launch a product that changes how people hear their world.
 The Role
 You'll shape the future of Loop's product line. You'll own product definition, align technical and business goals, and drive execution across hardware development—from concept and prototyping to tooling, production, and launch.
From early-stage discovery to post-launch iteration, you'll translate insights into decisions, guide trade-offs across engineering, industrial design, manufacturing, and operations, and keep the product on track. You balance imagination with precision—creating space for innovation while keeping delivery sharp.
This is a hands-on role where you'll be on-site 3–4 days a week, closely involved in the physical development of the product—working with prototypes, materials, and samples you can hold in your hands.
 What You'll Do
 Define the product vision using customer insights, market data, and technical trends
 Build the business case and roadmap to guide development and align stakeholders
 Lead trade-off decisions across design, engineering, manufacturing, and operations
 Anticipate late-stage challenges (e.g., regulatory compliance, tooling and production readiness, quality iteration) and manage resolution
 Set success metrics and use them to track impact and guide improvements
 Communicate strategy and updates clearly across all levels
 Mentor other PMs and contribute to the evolution of Loop's product management craft
 You Won't
 Build products based on assumptions instead of validated customer needs
 Focus on delivery without shaping product direction
 Wait for perfect certainty before prototyping, testing, and iterating
 Work in silos rather than aligning teams around a shared vision
 Prefer clear answers over navigating ambiguity
 Treat manufacturing and operations as someone else's problem
 How You'll Succeed
 You work with focus, energy, and clarity. You can zoom out to shape long-term vision and zoom in to remove daily roadblocks. You're decisive yet adaptable—comfortable in technical discussions but always anchored in customer value.
 Clear communication is one of your strengths. Whether working with leadership or cross-functional teams, you simplify complexity, create alignment, and keep everyone focused on what matters most.
 You think like a consumer, building intuitive, desirable products for people who choose to use your product, not who have to. You lead by example, align teams, and bring structure to the messy process of building from scratch.
 What You'll Bring
 8+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer electronics, consumer goods, or physical products
 A bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
 Proven experience delivering 0→1 physical products—from concept through manufacturing to market
 Experience managing late-stage complexity—design trade-offs, regulatory readiness, production ramp-up
 Strong financial and commercial understanding to support business decisions
 A clear track record of cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment
 A consumer-centric mindset and the ability to balance desirability, feasibility, and viability
 Loop isn't for everyone. We might not be a match if you:
 Prefer maintaining existing products over building what's next
 Like predictable environments where everything is already figured out
 Enjoy staying within your own function rather than bringing people together
 Prefer following a roadmap over helping define it
 See ambiguity as a blocker rather than an opportunity
 Aren't excited by the pace of building something new
 Still interested?
 Great. If you're excited about building bold physical products, shaping a new category, and doing the most meaningful work of your career, we'd love to hear from you.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.
In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.
As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.
For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.
This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

 Drive delivery across both products, maintaining clear roadmaps, delivery cadences and launch plans, with a pragmatic approach focused on launching initial capabilities and iterating based on feedback.
 Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.
 Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.

 Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.
 Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.
 Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

 du temps gagné pour les administrateurs de communauté grâce à l’automatisation

 Notre ambition est progressivement de construire une base qui s’améliore plutôt que de simplement stocker ce qu’on lui donne .

 Agents IA Créer un socle permettant à des agents de disposer d’instructions, de connaissances et de compétences, puis d’utiliser les outils et données AlumnForce en respectant les droits de chaque utilisateur.

linkedin:4481794960.desc:
Referment is working with a London-based company that has built an AI platform turning the data behind major construction projects into decisions their leaders can act on — forecasting delay and cost risk on large infrastructure and helping the people running those projects decide what to do about it. The underlying machine-learning capability is trained on one of the largest datasets of construction schedules in existence.
The company runs product differently from most. AI has collapsed the cost of building software, so its teams are organised into small squads of two to three people, and everyone in a squad is a contributor — there's no "write the spec and wait". As a Product Manager you'll lead one or more squads, own a quarter's mission, reconcile priorities when unplanned work lands, and make real trade-offs.
And you build. You'll prototype with AI tools, direct agents, review and edit generated code, and take ideas to working tests in days. Increasingly the product itself is agents, so you'll design what they do, what they must never do, and where humans stay in the loop.
 The Role
 Own your squads' quarter: plan it, reconcile it against unplanned work, and deliver it, making build/kill decisions on evidence.
 Build rather than brief — write clear specs, prompt agents, and review and edit generated code and output.
 Design and ship AI agents, defining their behaviour, guardrails and the context and tools they use.
 Run structured evaluations — define what good looks like before building, then prove it with representative datasets and scoring rubrics.
 Help people decide under uncertainty, turning risk and forecasts into something a busy executive can act on.
 Get close to customers through user and buyer research and client meetings.
 Lead contributors rather than a process, coordinating dependencies across squads.
 What We're Looking For
 Two-plus years owning a B2B or enterprise AI or SaaS product — accountable for a product area, with shipped features real clients depend on.
 You already build with AI daily: prototypes, analysis, and working code you review and edit rather than write from scratch.
 You've built with LLMs in earnest — enough to reason about model choice, prompting, context, retrieval and tool use.
 You can take an ambiguous problem, get to what customers actually need, and make the right calls through understanding the trade-offs.
 You've killed things — you can point to experiments you ran and the roadmap items that died as a result.
 Fluent with data, including designing structured evaluations rather than only reading dashboards.
 Sharp communication: able to make a complex trade-off legible to an engineer, a customer and a leadership team member.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with a product built on data science or machine learning, and comfort discussing forecasting and uncertainty.
 Experience shipping to senior operational or finance buyers.
 Some understanding of construction, planning and/or risk.
 A formal technical background.
 This could suit a product manager from an AI or data-heavy B2B product, or someone with a strong technical and analytical background who wants real ownership in a small squad.
#Referment

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.



What we're looking for

 - 8+ years in the software industry, with direct ownership of an AI or LLM-powered product in a product management or engineering leadership role

 - Hands-on experience building and shipping agent-based systems - you understand tool use, planning loops, multi-step reasoning, and how agents fail

 - Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can read model outputs, traces, and evals with confidence

 - Strong product sense and systems thinking - you know when to move fast and when to invest in foundational work, and you have sharp opinions on how agents should communicate, recover from errors, and earn user trust

 - Preferred: Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation frameworks; prior experience operating at the frontier where best practices are still being written



What you'll do

 - Represent the user -  synthesize findings on agent performance and behavior, and bring them to the team with clarity and conviction

 - Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, eval analysis, prompt experimentation, and crafting messaging for upcoming agent capabilities

 - Own the quality bar for agent outputs - drive eval infrastructure, monitor regressions, and ensure the agent improves with every release

 - Scope ruthlessly - ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't

 - Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to communicate new agent capabilities effectively

 - Projects you'll tackle first: Rebuilding the agent evaluation framework to catch regressions before they ship; running discovery on the biggest gaps in agent reliability and trust; defining and shipping the first iteration of improved agent error recovery and communication



About your application 

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Trading OS team, reporting to the Director of OTA Platform. You’ll work closely with lead engineers, Revenue Management, and commercial leaders to define and deliver the long-term product vision for Trading OS, creating shared data, tools, and capabilities that power pricing, packaging, promotions, and availability across markets. Together, the team will focus on enabling commercial and AI teams to configure, test, and automate commercial changes safely and quickly at scale, reducing dependency on engineering and enhancing decision-making.

Trading OS sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.



Your day-to-day:

 - Partner with engineering, Revenue Management, and commercial leaders to define the Trading OS roadmap, outcomes, metrics, and investment priorities.

 - Build flexible tools, APIs, and data models that enable commercial teams to configure, test, and roll out pricing, packaging, and availability changes.

 - Work closely with Engineering on technical design, service boundaries, data contracts, and scalable architecture for AI-assisted decisioning.

 - Improve the quality, reliability, and visibility of commercial data to enable faster, engineering-independent commercial changes.

 - Use data and controlled experimentation to measure operator efficiency, engineering effort avoided, platform adoption, and commercial impact.

 - Drive platform adoption by establishing clear documentation, onboarding, and feedback loops for internal product and commercial consumers.



Your skillset:

 - Proven record of platform product leadership owning technical, API-heavy, data-rich, or internal platform products used by multiple teams.

 - Systems thinking ability to model complex dependencies across data, services, and workflows into stable, composable capabilities.

 - Strong technical fluency across APIs, data models, distributed systems, configuration engines, and observability to collaborate credibly with engineering.

 - Commercial judgement with the ability to connect platform strategy to margin, trading objectives, and customer value.

 - Expertise in data and experimentation, comfortable defining metrics, designing controlled tests, and using data to guide decisions.

 - Outstanding execution and communication skills to navigate ambiguity, balance platform health with delivery, and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.



The interview journey:

 - Talent acquisition screening - 30 minutes

 - First stage with the hiring manager - 45 minutes

 - Final stage with key stakeholders, including a platform case to present - 1 hour

 - Behavioural and culture conversation with VP of Product - 45 minutes



Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

 - Ability to buy and sell annual leave

 - Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme 

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

loveholidays:859daa11-176b-4a99-9213-41a.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
loveholidays:859daa11-176b-4a99-9213-41a.desc:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit within the Shopping team, reporting to the Lead Product Manager. The Shopping team turns travel supply into accurate, commercially optimised, bookable and payable holidays. It provides shared data and services that help customers, teams and partners make better selling decisions.

On the payments side, you’ll work closely with Engineering and Commercial Payments to own product strategy and delivery for the Payments platform. Together, the team will make it easier for other teams to offer, operate and improve payments without rebuilding the same logic in each customer journey. You will:

 - Build a flexible international payments platform: Define the shared services, data and APIs that meet local customer and market needs, while allowing payment methods to be launched and managed consistently across markets and customer journeys.

 - Create reliable foundations: Improve the payment data, provider integrations and fraud controls that keep payments secure, dependable and easier to manage.

 - Make payment methods easier to launch: Help teams configure, test and release supported methods safely, with less engineering work and clearer ownership.

 - Enable payment optimisation at scale: Provide shared data and platform capabilities that help teams improve payment success and offer relevant payment methods across markets and journeys. Apply AI to improve insight and enable responsible automation where it delivers measurable value.

Your day-to-day:

 - Working with your lead engineer and stakeholders to set the Payments vision, roadmap and success measures.

 - Working with market experts, commercial teams and Customer Product teams to understand payment needs. Provide data to inform their decisions and translate agreed requirements into reusable platform capabilities.

 - Exposing reliable payment data and provider insights so teams can understand failures, drop-off, acceptance rates and customer pain points. Work with those teams to prioritise the platform improvements needed to improve payment performance.

 - Leading delivery: Lead work across payment services, provider integrations, payment data, configuration and fraud controls. Keep the platform straightforward for other teams to use.

 - Working directly with payment providers and aggregators to solve issues, evaluate new capabilities and hold partners to the standards customers need.

 - Explaining trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and building agreement on decisions that span several teams.



Your skillset:

 - Platform product experience: You have owned a technical, API-led, data-rich or internal platform product that is used by more than one team or customer journey and involves a payments ecosystem.

 - Systems thinking: You can understand how payment data, provider integrations, customer journeys, commercial rules and operational processes fit together, then turn that into reusable product capabilities.

 - Technical fluency: You can work closely with engineers on APIs, integration patterns, data models, reliability, observability, security and migration work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can make sound product trade-offs with them.

 - Payments and commercial judgement: You understand the payment ecosystem and how method availability, payment success, fraud, cost and customer trust affect growth.

 - Data-led problem solving: You are comfortable using data to investigate problems, define useful measures and judge whether a change is improving payment performance.

 - Customer empathy: You understand that payments can be stressful, especially when people are making high-value holiday purchases or managing payments after booking. You use this to advocate for clear, dependable journeys.

 - Strong delivery and communication: You can lead complex work through ambiguity, make priorities clear and bring technical, commercial and operational stakeholders with you. You deliver iteratively, focusing each step on meaningful value while keeping the team aligned to a clear long-term direction.

 - AI literacy: You use AI tools confidently and can demonstrate their impact. You understand their strengths and limitat

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Product Management (Pricing & Assurance) 
Who is Mastercard? 
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 
Overview 
Mastercard’s Transfer Solutions team in EEMEA is driving at scale innovation and growth to meet today’s demands for simple, certain, and secure international and domestic payments by individuals and businesses of all sizes. Mastercard Move is a portfolio of integrated assets and capabilities designed to service key verticals, customer segments and multiple payment flows. Through simple connectivity means, we enable partners the ability to reach a variety of endpoints—account, card, mobile wallet, cards and cash out locations —nearly anywhere in the world. 
The organization is looking for a Director, Product Management (Pricing & Assurance), Mastercard Move as part of the EEMEA Product Management Team for Cross Border Payments, to work with customers, who are primarily large Financial Institutions, Fin Techs, Bureau De Changes / Exchange Houses or Government Clearing Schemes to further the strategic and commercial agenda of Mastercard in the region focused on Cross Border Payments, which includes Low Value B2B / Commercial Payments, P2P Remittances and Purpose-based payments like Bill Payments, Tuition Payments, Utility, Social Security etc. 
The ideal candidate is aware of the Cross-Border Payments landscape and is aware of the intricate dynamics of how money moves between Institutions and Borders, being familiar with the role Correspondent and Bilateral Banking arrangements play in the setup, the evolving nature of SWIFT (and its evolution to ISO messaging standards), existing Settlement & Funding mediums, helping to identify the gaps and solutionize areas where Mastercard’s own and partner led solutions can add value. 
Role 
• This is a Pricing and Assurance role at its heart where you will work with Product Sales teams / Account Managers to ensure we are able to provide best commercial value to our customers alongside safeguarding long-term financial interests for the company. 
• Often, you would work with customers directly to help them formulate the right value story / financial model to ensure the product is able to provide the best Value Proposition to our clients and their customers. 
• Prepare / facilitate complex business cases within Mastercard at a customer / deal / portfolio level to ensure the right investments / financial support / prioritization is done for opportunities worth the merit. 
• Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle for the business, and partner with Finance colleagues upstream and Sales colleagues downstream to ensure we can project and hit the business numbers. 
• Formulate and track underlying business driver and enabler metrics on weekly / fortnightly / monthly level with cross-functional teams – including delivery timelines, growth rates etc. as relevant. 
• Executive presentation outlining business direction and facilitation of QBR / MBR with senior leaders and often with strategic clients. Partner for strategy refresh cycles to evaluate what’s working v/s not. 
• Act as PMO for key internal work-streams which affects revenue realization – like Network health and breadth, FX constructs, Deal Incentive structures etc. 
All About You 
The ideal candidate for this position should: 
• Understands cross-border payments at its’ core and the lever(s) that influence the commercial health of the product and the business at large. 
• Understanding of financial and reporting principles of key metrices that influence business development. 
• Be able to work horizontally in a highly matrixed organization with overlapping ownership and influence. Be able to get the work done through influence, reasoning rather than authority.
