 Title and Summary 
Principal Product Manager -Technical 
Overview:
This role will be part of Mastercard’s Reactive Systems Architecture (RSA) organization, which underpins the company’s real‑time, event‑driven payment capabilities. RSA provides the foundational platforms, frameworks, and shared services that enable Mastercard to process payments at global scale with high throughput, low latency, resilience, and fault tolerance.
We partner with application teams to design, build, and operate mission‑critical payment applications—spanning Domestic, Cross‑Border, and Bill Payments—that are powered by RSA’s event‑driven platforms such as Axon (Kafka‑based streaming), NATS, and supporting shared services.
Together, RSA and the Applications team enable Mastercard product teams to focus on delivering business value, while the underlying architecture handles the complex non‑functional requirements essential to modern payment systems—scalability, resiliency, availability, observability, and security. Real‑time payment technology is central to Mastercard’s strategy to define a world beyond cash, and this team plays a key role in building and scaling the platforms and applications that make that vision possible.
Why Join This Team?
• Do you want to be part of a team shaping Mastercard’s real‑time, event‑driven payment platforms that operate at global scale?
• Are you excited to design and deliver systems that are responsive, resilient, elastic, and message‑driven, aligned with the principles of Reactive Systems?
• Do you enjoy building and collaborating with high‑performing, diverse engineering teams across the globe?
Would you like to work in a highly visible, strategically critical engineering organization that directly powers Mastercard’s future payment flows?
The Role:
What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day
• Be customer obsessed: Develop & provide the organization with a deep appreciation for customer needs, the ecosystem and the key market dynamics
• Set the vision: Lead multiple teams in adoption of lean product management practices: Define, establish, and continually refine a domain product vision & objectives, establish a product charter, and create and maintain a domain roadmap
• Define requirements: Translate product requirements into clearly defined epics, features and stories with clear & measurable outcomes, ensuring mutual understanding. An understanding of technical architectures and Event messaging frameworks is a must. 
• Manage strategic alignment across teams: Working with product owners with each scrum team, ensure backlogs are properly prioritized and refined according to anticipated business value & measurable outcomes
• Agile Mindset: Advocate for taking an agile approach to product development through all activities from defining an epic to writing acceptance criteria on a user story.
• Lead the design and build of the product with engineering: Work closely- as one agile team- across a product domain
• Work across cross functional teams: Work with cross functional teams to plan work, understand dependencies, and minimize time to market and errors
• Oversee delivery and testing of product features (e.g., serving and enabling scrum teams)
• Manage the operation: Own the overall health and “run” of your domain. Escalate critical operational issues to Real Time Payments management teams and discuss resolutions to ensure operational stability with the concerned delivery teams 
• Measure outcomes & seek continuous improvements: Evaluate & seek to improve existing practices, metrics, and roles to continually optimize. Own and deliver on post-launch reviews and customer feedback, and incorporate this information into the future launch plans
All About You and What you need to bring:
• Strong product management or new product development and experience shipping high-quality products in the payments industry. Understands and can explain the business context and the associated customer use cases
• Experience in Lean Product management and Lean management principles and practices. Can deliver high quality technology products/services in a high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly
• Comprehensive experience in agile delivery methodologies (scrum, Kanban, etc.), CI/CD and modern DevOps based PDLC and SDLC. Technical savviness to enable TDD and BDD.
• Track record of successful delivery of product features from design, development, deployment and customer integration.

Product Manager, Payment Threat Intelligence 
Overview:
Mastercard’s Services team is responsible for safeguarding trust in payments, both now and in the future. We ensure that transactions and interactions are safe, simple and smart. The Card & Payment Ecosystem Security organization within Services is responsible for developing and managing cybersecurity solutions that help build trust in the Mastercard ecosystem while increasing Mastercard’s posture as a leader in the cybersecurity industry. 
About the Role:
Mastercard is using global threat intelligence to secure today’s digital economy – in the payments ecosystem and beyond. The Product Manager will manage the threat intelligence process that supports the Card & Payment Ecosystem Security product function. The role is responsible for developing threat intelligence deliverables derived from business needs, market opportunities, and cyber-enabled fraud trends. This role will manage a team of intelligence analysts who research and understand the cyber threats impacting merchants and financial services.
Role & Responsibilities
• Lead a team of analysts responsible for researching, analyzing, and writing finished intelligence reports on cyber threats impacting the payment ecosystem.
• Conduct in-depth research on cyber threat actors, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and develop actionable intelligence for non-technical audiences.
• Author and oversee the production of high-quality white papers and intelligence reports that distill complex cyber threat information into clear, concise, and actionable insights.
• Focus on the big-picture threats and emerging trends while identifying and prioritizing what is most important to the organization and its clients.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and global threat landscapes to inform strategic decisions.
• Build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, incorporating feedback to improve intelligence products and processes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure intelligence reports align with business needs.
• Manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously, ensuring timely completion while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail. 
All About You 
• Extensive background in Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), with a deep understanding of the cyber threat landscape, IOCs, and TTPs relevant to the payment ecosystem.
• Demonstrated familiarity building relationships to further complex cyber crime investigations and actions.
• Strong writing skills, with the ability to craft clear, concise, and actionable intelligence reports and white papers for a range of audiences, from technical experts to business leaders. 
• Proven experience in managing teams, fostering collaboration, and driving performance to meet deadlines. 
• Able to work in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a high level of output quality. 
Cyber Threat Intelligence certifications preferred and/or an advanced degree in the field. This role may require a CTI-related writing sample. 
Applicants are encouraged to submit a sample of work that demonstrates their ability to produced finished intelligence.

 Title and Summary 
Cyber Risk Quantification Product Manager 
The Cyber Risk Quantification Product Manager role is designed for a candidate with strong experience in quantitative cyber risk analysis, FAIR-based methodologies, and product-oriented problem-solving. 
The role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with leading cybersecurity, risk, product, analytics, and engineering experts within our cybersecurity products organization. The ideal candidate will combine cyber risk expertise, analytical rigor, and cross-functional collaboration skills to help develop clear, scalable, and defensible cyber risk quantification capabilities.
This role requires someone who can work across cybersecurity, risk, product, analytics, and engineering teams to translate cyber risk concepts into product requirements, analytical approaches, and clear user-facing explanations. The position is well suited for a hands-on product professional who understands quantitative risk modeling and can make complex methodologies usable for business and technical audiences.
The successful candidate will bring practical experience in cyber risk quantification, model development, model validation, financial impact analysis, and methodology documentation, with the ability to support both strategic planning and day-to-day execution.
Role Overview
The ideal candidate is a strategic and analytical thinker who combines hands-on problem-solving with strong product judgment and serves as a subject-matter expert in cyber risk quantification and cyber risk analytics, with experience applying FAIR-based models, including FAIR, FAIR-CAM, and FAIR-MAM.
The candidate will help translate cyber risk quantification methodologies, model assumptions, assessment insights, control effectiveness concepts, financial impact analysis, and loss-data considerations into clear product requirements, analytical logic, and documentation.
The right candidate understands how quantitative cyber risk assessments work in real-world environments and can use that insight to improve methodology clarity, model usability, and product applicability. The candidate is a fast learner who takes ownership, independently drives initiatives, collaborates effectively across teams, and applies a creative, solution-oriented mindset to complex cyber risk challenges.

• Translate cyber risk quantification methodologies into clear product requirements, analytical logic, model assumptions, and user-facing explanations.
• Apply cybersecurity, threat, exposure, control, and financial-impact concepts to support practical cyber risk quantification use cases and model inputs.
• Work with product, engineering, analytics, cybersecurity, and risk stakeholders to refine requirements, validate assumptions, and support practical application of quantitative risk capabilities.
• Maintain clear documentation that explains how models work, what assumptions are used, and how results, recommendations, and analytical outputs should be interpreted.
Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in cyber risk quantification, quantitative cyber risk assessment, or related cyber risk analytics roles.
• Practical experience applying FAIR-based methodologies, including FAIR, FAIR-CAM, or FAIR-MAM, to cyber risk scenarios, assessments, or product use cases.
• Experience building, calibrating, validating, or explaining quantitative risk models, including model assumptions, inputs, outputs, and limitations.
• Strong understanding of model governance, validation, documentation, assumptions management, explainability, and methodology defensibility for quantitative cyber risk models.
• Strong foundation in statistics, probability, financial impact estimation, and ROI analysis, with the ability to apply these skills to cyber risk quantification.
• Working knowledge of cybersecurity and risk management frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27000-series standards, MITRE ATT&CK, exposure management concepts, and related standards.
• Experience working with product, engineering, analytics, cybersecurity, or risk teams to translate analytical concepts into practical product requirements and supporting documentation.

 Title and Summary 
Director, Product Management, Payment Performance Intelligence 
Help Shape the Future of Payment Intelligence
Every day, billions of payment transactions power the global economy. Hidden within them are payment performance issues that can silently impact revenue, customer experience, operational efficiency, and brand reputation.
At Mastercard, we believe no payment performance issue should go unnoticed. With that in mind, we built MEDI to ensure that no critical payment performance signal goes unanswered.
Through real-time intelligence and AI-driven insights, MEDI helps customers identify issues faster, resolve them sooner, and protect business performance. Our vision is to become the network’s real-time payment performance intelligence layer, turning billions of transactions into actionable insights that strengthen trust, resilience, and performance.
We're looking for a Director, Product Management to lead MEDI's next wave of growth and the team responsible for defining and commercializing future product innovations.
This is not a traditional product management role focused on incremental feature development. You will lead a team focused on discovering growth opportunities, engaging directly with customers, evaluating emerging technologies, and transforming market needs into scalable products with measurable global impact.
You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, customer discovery, AI, commercialization, technology, and people leadership, helping shape one of Mastercard's fastest-growing intelligence businesses.
What Makes This Role Exciting

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
 
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
 
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.

 Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
 Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
 Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
What you will need 
Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
 Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking

mentimeter:4918234101.title: Senior Product Manager, Data / ML
mentimeter:4918234101.desc:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.
Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.
 About the role 
 AI is changing how people create and consume content, and the Insights product area is where Mentimeter turns that shift into an advantage rather than something we retrofit later. It's the area that decides what every one of our users sees, learns and does next, to turn data into something valuable enough to come back for, and in turn drive retention and expansion for our business.
 As Senior Product Manager, Data / ML, you'll own the data and ML depth of Insights: the intelligence that turns every interaction into sharper results, insights and recommendations, pulls in context from inside and outside Mentimeter, and gets better the more it's used. With 300 million users' worth of interaction data behind it, the mandate is to turn that into a defensible asset. The data and ML is the means; a system that drives measurable outcomes for users and the business is the end.
 This is a senior, hands-on role with a clear mandate. You'll report to the Product Director of Insights: the Director owns the area's place in company strategy and its org shape, while you own the data and ML depth that delivers it. You'll work alongside the other product managers in the area, our Staff Engineers, our Science Lead, the Office of the CTO, and our data platform teams. The exact shape of the teams is still forming, and you'll help shape it.
 In your first year, success looks like a clear direction the area is bought into, and the first solid evidence that the system is compounding.

Senior Product Manager, Cluster Scalability
 Location: Dublin
 About the Role
 MongoDB is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own scalability for the Atlas data platform. Atlas is how the world’s most demanding applications run on MongoDB — from real-time gaming and financial transactions to AI workloads with unpredictable traffic patterns. When those applications grow, slow down, spike, or contract, scalability is the layer that decides whether the customer trusts us to keep running their business.
 This role owns the end-to-end product experience for how customers scale up, scale down, and horizontally scale their Atlas deployments. That includes vertical scaling (instance tier changes), autoscaling, horizontal scaling (sharding and shard key strategy), and the operational workflows around all of them. You will set the strategy, drive execution with engineering, and be accountable for measurable year-over-year improvements in how reliably and predictably customers scale.
 We care less about whether you’ve worked on databases before and more about whether you’re the kind of PM who can ramp fast on a hard technical domain, form a clear opinion about what needs to happen, and defend that opinion to senior engineers, field partners, and enterprise CTOs, especially when they disagree with you. Database and scaling concepts are teachable. Judgment, conviction, and crispness are not.
 Responsibilities
       Set a clear, opinionated vision and strategy for Atlas cluster scalability and translate it into concrete, prioritized bets each release.
       Own the end-to-end roadmap for vertical scaling, autoscaling, and horizontal scaling, including the operational and observability surfaces customers rely on during scaling events.
       Make hard prioritization calls, including saying no to things with real customer or leadership support, and own those decisions and their consequences.
       Build deep technical understanding of Atlas scaling internals (instance tier mechanics, autoscaler logic, sharding, balancer behavior, capacity headroom) and use it to shape requirements and tradeoffs with engineering. You don’t need to know this on day one. You do need to know it deeply by month two.
       Represent product direction with conviction to senior engineering leaders, field partners, and enterprise customers, especially when they disagree.
       Stay close to customers and field partners to deeply understand scaling pain points, failure patterns, and the moments where trust is won or lost.
       Define success metrics for scalability, build analytics that surface issues early, and use data to inform clear, timely decisions under ambiguity.
       Lead proactive, cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Docs, Support, Marketing, and Sales to ship reliable, high-quality scaling experiences and accelerate adoption.
       Mentor junior PMs, contribute to strategic product thinking across teams, and influence leadership-level product decisions, all while operating without direct reports.
       Be accountable to year-over-year growth on the metrics that matter for Atlas scalability.
 Requirements
 Required qualifications
       5+ years of product management experience on technically complex, infrastructure-level products. Database, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure experience is a plus but not required. We care about your ability to ramp fast on hard technical domains and make sound product decisions once you do.
       Demonstrated success owning enterprise-grade, technical products end-to-end — not just shipping them, but delivering measurable customer and business outcomes you can quantify.
       Technical fluency: comfortable discussing architecture, failure modes, performance characteristics, and tradeoffs with senior engineers, and connecting technical decisions directly to customer outcomes. You don’t need to know what an autoscaler does on day one. You do need to be the kind of PM who will understand it deeply within your first month and have an opinion about how it affects the customer experience by month two.
       Track record of taking products from 0 to 1 and from 1 to 50 — building something new and scaling what works.
       Strong customer-orientation and field-connection, regularly engaging directly with customers and field teams and translating their input into clear requirements and roadmap decisions.
       Excellent written and verbal communication: crisp, high-quality artifacts and the ability to tailor the message by audience (engineering, executives, customers, field). In this role you will represent product direction to enterprise CTOs and to senior engineering leaders who may disagree with your priorities. You need to hold the room.
       Strong analytical skills and metrics rigor, including defining success metrics, instrumenting and debugging analytics, and using data to inform (but not replace) judgment.
       Demonstrated decision-making speed and conviction

n26:8158787.title: Senior Product Manager - Conversational Banking
n26:8158787.desc:
About the opportunity
 Conversational Banking is how N26 scales support without scaling headcount at the same rate. Our ambition is banking as a non event: clients get help in their channel and language of choice, and most issues resolve before a human agent ever needs to be involved. We build the intelligence in house — N26 owns its own orchestration and intelligence layer rather than renting it from vendors — and the programme is now shifting from an assistant that answers questions to a system that acts on them.
 As Senior Product Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of high impact conversational capabilities and autonomous journeys end to end — from discovery through delivery to measured resolution outcomes. Working alongside Lead Product Managers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers, you will operate at the intersection of applied AI, banking operations, and regulation to ship experiences that millions of clients across Europe rely on daily.
 The segment has been newly formed and expanded, the platform foundations are proven, and the interesting work is just starting: taking journeys from containment to genuine autonomous resolution, on infrastructure the bank owns. You will join a high performing team with high autonomy and real ownership from day one.
 In this role, you will 
 Drive capability execution: Take full product ownership of complex client journeys and agent facing capabilities, translating strategic priorities into well defined roadmaps and squad deliverables.
 Ground everything in evidence: Lead discovery on contact drivers, building problem statements from real customer feedback, operational data, and contact center insights rather than assumptions.
 Ship agentic capabilities: Work daily with engineering and applied AI teams to move journeys from answering to acting — delivering safe, autonomous resolution with robust guardrails and escalation paths.
 Own your metrics: Instrument your domain with resolution first metrics, containment rates, and counter metrics to prove that operational efficiency never compromises quality or customer trust.
 Bridge tech and operations: Collaborate closely with operations, service partners, and peer product teams so that AI capabilities integrate seamlessly into agent workflows and back office tools.
 Build for a regulated bank: Design compliance, auditability, data privacy, and client protection into every capability from the start.
 What you bring 
 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of shipping complex digital products or major automation capabilities end to end.
 Hands on experience with AI powered, conversational, or LLM based products in a live production environment.
 Highly proficient in analyzing datasets, defining metric frameworks, and separating signal from vanity metrics.
 A pragmatic bias for action, comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast moving programme.
 Nice to have 
 Experience in banking, fintech, or another regulated industry.
 Exposure to contact centre operations, BPO environments, or customer service tooling.
 What’s in it for you 
 Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
 Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
 A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
 An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
 High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
 A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.
 Who we are 
 N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
 We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.
 We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.
 Sounds good? Apply now for this position. 
 Equal Opportunities 
 We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.
 We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. n26:8267143.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
n26:8267143.desc:
About the opportunity
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.
 Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.
 In this role, you will 
 Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
 Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
 Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
 Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
 Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
 Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.
 What you need to be successful 
 Background & Experience 
 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
 High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
 Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.
 Technical & Domain Skills 
 Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
 Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
 Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
 Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.
 Traits 
 Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
 Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
 Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.
 What’s in it for you 
 Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
 Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
 A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for fri

n8n:163162f1-9873-45b4-932e-aff27beea78a.desc:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

nium:9b416d47-9390-4f22-8d97-727a066d307.desc:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. 


About the Role 
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol

Responsibilities
Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it.
 Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line.
 Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience.
 Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade.
 Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy.
 Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal.
Requirements 
7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required.
 You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck.
 Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it.
 Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions.
 Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against.
 Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off.
How We’ll Measure Success
Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
 Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
 On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
 Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
 Regulatory coverage: number of markets wit

 Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. Okta Customer Identity (OCI) is the identity platform behind that promise for the applications our customers build for their own customers: the login, MFA, and account management layer for millions of end users across B2B, B2B2C and B2C products. OCI sits alongside Okta Workforce Identity (OWI) as one of the two halves of the Okta platform.
 We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to grow OCI's footprint inside our existing enterprise base and to incubate the next generation of platform capabilities. This is a builder's role. You'll spend a good chunk of your time in true zero-to-one territory: sizing a raw opportunity, proving it out with a design partner or two, and turning it into a capability that ships and gets adopted. You'll spend the rest of it as the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, and go-to-market, making sure those bets land in the field.
 What you will own
 New Capability Incubation: Own the pipeline of zero-to-one bets on the Okta’s Okta Customer Identity platform, from a rough problem statement through a validated design and a shipped v1. You'll decide what's worth building before anyone asks engineering to build it.
 Platform Growth: Drive the product side of Okta Customer Identity platform expansion into our existing enterprise base. You'll turn a hypothesis about why they haven't adopted the Okta Customer Identity platform into product changes that remove the reason.
 Cross-functional Delivery: Be the person engineering, design, research, and go-to-market call when a new Okta Customer Identity platform capability needs a decision. You'll write the specs, run the reviews, and keep a dozen loosely connected workstreams moving toward the same launch.
 A day in the life
 Your day splits between zero-to-one thinking and shipping discipline. You might start the morning studying churn or expansion data for a segment we don't serve well yet, trying to figure out whether the gap is a feature gap or a positioning gap. An hour later you're on a call with a design partner customer, walking through a rough prototype and taking notes on what confused them.

You write plainly. Your specs read like an explanation to a smart colleague, not a wish list.
 In the afternoon you sync with go-to-market and your PMM partner on how a capability in progress should be positioned once it ships, and you flag anything that changes the pitch. You close the day presenting to a customer or prospect, walking them through what's shipped and what's coming on the roadmap.

The decisions made here directly move the needle on conversion, revenue, and customer trust. This is the toughest product role at Paddle, and we're looking for someone who is energised by that.

You will own the Checkout product end-to-end: its strategy, its roadmap, its performance, and its commercial outcomes. You'll operate as the senior product voice in the room with our executive team, engineering leaders, and largest customers, and you'll be expected to set the bar – not just for what we ship, but for how the wider product org makes decisions, runs discovery, and uses data.

You'll work in a trio with a strong engineering lead and an experienced product designer, with daily exposure to Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Risk, Finance, and Exco. Given the cross-functional intensity of the work, this role requires regular in-person collaboration with the Checkout team and the wider Payments group.

This is an opportunity for a staff-level operator who wants to own a product that genuinely matters – one with hard technical problems, real commercial stakes, and the platform to influence company strategy.



What you'll do: 

Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:

 - Own the long-term vision and strategy for Checkout, grounded in market trends, payments innovation, customer needs, and Paddle's commercial goals. Translate this into a roadmap you can defend at Exco and to customers.

 - Make – and stand behind – the tough prioritisation calls. Navigate ambiguous, multi-stakeholder trade-offs where the "right" answer requires deep judgement across technical constraints, commercial impact, compliance, and UX.

 - Set the bar for discovery and prioritisation across the wider Payments group; coach other PMs on how to do this well.

Product Development & Delivery:

 - Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-faceted initiatives without needing oversight. Define and enforce the delivery standards (discovery, specs, experimentation, launch quality) that the rest of the product team operates against.

 - Work in a tight trio with engineering and design to ship fast, instrument well, and iterate based on real customer signal. Use AI tooling to compress the loop from idea to spec to prototype – we expect ideas to be testable in days, not weeks.

 - Run a continuous programme of optimisation – A/B tests, beta programmes, usability research – to compound conversion and UX gains across a high-volume, consumer-facing surface.

Data, Metrics & Commercial Impact:

 - Own the KPIs that matter for Checkout (conversion, authorisation rates, revenue impact, NPS, etc.) and weave them into the strategic narrative for the business.

 - Dive into data independently. We don't expect you to wait for an analyst; we expect you to pull the numbers (with AI help where it accelerates you), form a hypothesis, and bring a recommendation.

 - Use product data to influence business strategy beyond your immediate roadmap – pricing, GTM, risk policy, settlement, etc.

Stakeholder Management & Storytelling:

 - Align senior stakeholders – including Exco, Sales leadership, and key customers – around the Checkout strategy. Tailor the message, never the substance.

 - Craft compelling written narratives. At staff level we expect your docs to be the artefact that drives decisions, not a deck or a meeting.

 - Be a credible technical partner to engineering on complex payments, integrations, and platform decisions.

GTM & Customer Proximity:

 - Oversee GTM for Checkout launches across multiple customer segments and geographies, working with Marketing, Sales, Solutions, and Support.

 - Shape the customer-centric culture of the team – consistently in front of customers yourself, and building the processes that keep the rest of the team close to them too.



We'd love to hear from you if you:

 - You're used to owning a high-stakes, high-complexity product end-to-end with clear, measurable business impact – or you're a senior PM who is unambiguously operating beyond your title.

 - You have specific, hands-on experience with payment

parloa:649b248d-c453-499c-9af6-bceb6ef25.desc:
ABOUT PARLOA

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com,  HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.


ABOUT PARLOA

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com http://booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale. 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Infrastructure Platform team owns the foundation that every other engineering team at Parloa builds on: cloud infrastructure, provisioning and orchestration, CI/CD, and the runtime environments that our AI agents execute in. Its current flagship initiative, Deployment Stamps, is re-platforming how Parloa delivers isolated, reliable, and compliant environments across public cloud and customer-owned private cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

We are looking for a Staff or Principal Product Manager to own the product management for this team. This is one of the most technical product roles at Parloa. You will not be writing user stories for a UI, you will be shaping the architecture-adjacent product strategy for a platform whose "customers" are largely internal engineering teams and the most demanding enterprise security, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders on the other side of the table.

This is a builder role in a domain where the playbook is still being written. If you want to define what "good" looks like for enterprise-grade AI infrastructure, data residency and sovereignty, isolation, and a multi-cloud operating model, and you are energized by deeply technical problems and technical stakeholders, this is it.

A note on background: We have a strong preference for candidates who have spent time as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or senior engineer before moving into product. This domain rewards genuine technical depth and the instinct to earn trust with engineers by speaking their language. A former EM who has since developed strong product judgment is exactly the profile we have in mind.

 


AREAS OF OWNERSHIP:

 - Own the Infrastructure Platform product strategy and roadmap: translating reliability, isolation, data-residency, and multi-cloud goals into a sequenced, outcomes-driven plan that engineering can execute against.

 - Be the voice of internal and enterprise customers: your primary users are Parloa engineering teams (developer experience, deployment, runtime) and your most demanding external stakeholders are enterprise CISOs, CIOs, and infrastructure leaders with strict compliance and sovereignty requirements.

 - Drive discovery and write the PRDs that frame outcomes (isolation, compliance, availability) without over-prescribing implementation, then partner with engineering leads and architects to pressure-test feasibility and trade-offs.

 - Own the hard prioritization calls: balancing near-term delivery milestones against longer-term architecture evolution, and making explicit, defensible decisions about scope, sequencing, and risk.

 - Define and track the metrics that matter for a platform: availability and SLA attainment, provisioning lead time, deployment frequency, change-failure rate, adoption by internal teams, and developer satisfaction.

 - Establish mechanisms, not just features: repeatable processes for region readiness/certification, release management, and cross-team alignment that scale as the platform grows from a handful of environments to many.

 - Align a broad, technical stakeholder set: Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal/Compliance, and the customer-facing teams (Deployment, Sales Engineering) who need to position the platform's capabilities to enterprise accounts.

 - Connect the platform to revenue: articulate how infrastructure capabilities (e.g., data residency, private cloud, isolation tiers) unlock enterprise deals, new regions, and expansion, and feed that back into prioritization.

 - Communicate clearly across technical and business contexts: equally comfortable in an architecture review and in a leadership readout.

 


WHO YOU ARE:

 - A technical-leadership background. 7+ years of combined engineering and product experience for Staff (L4); 10+ years with demonstrated product leaders

payoneer:7566798.desc:
About Payoneer 
 Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
 By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
 The Role   
 Make every Payoneer capability accessible programmatically — through self-serve APIs and AI-native MCP interfaces — so customers and their AI agents can work with Payoneer wherever they operate, without opening the app.   
 This is a new, high-ownership area with no prior product owner — strategy, vision, and roadmap are yours to define. Payoneer already exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks, capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. As Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations, you’ll own the strategy to close that gap, turn API access into a growth and retention lever, and take our MCP / AI-native layer from proof-of-concept to production. You’ll work across Product, R&D, Risk, Security, Legal, and GTM, and report into the Platform Product leadership team.   
 What you’ll do   
 Take the MCP to production.  Take Payoneer’s MCP work from proof-of-concept to production – exposing capabilities such as balance, transactions, payouts, and FX as tools that AI agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) can call. Partner with Account Security and Core Foundations on auth, governance, and a secure read-first rollout.   
 Turn API access into a growth lever . Payoneer exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks — capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. Own the strategy to close that gap end-to-end, with self-serve onboarding, developer experience, and API governance as the execution threads.   
 Turn demand into a roadmap.  Synthesize signals from CSM, Sales, and regional GTM teams (EMEA, LATAM, APAC) into a prioritized, evidence-backed roadmap, and prove the business case – including the retention impact of API-integrated customers.   
 Lead cross-functionally.  Coordinate Risk (eligibility), Security (MCP/API risk model), Legal (data sharing and LLM integrations), Pricing, and Engineering to unblock launches and land outcomes, not just features.   
 Who you are   
 6+ years in product management, including significant experience owning API, platform, developer-facing, or integration products.   
 Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing REST APIs, webhooks/events, authentication (OAuth), SDKs, and integration architecture directly with engineers.   
 Proven ability to take an ambiguous, unowned area and create clarity – strategy, roadmap, and shipped product – with a high degree of independence.   
 Track record of building self-serve or developer experiences, and of driving measurable adoption and time-to-value improvements.   
 Excellent cross-functional leadership: you align Risk, Security, Legal, GTM, and Engineering around shared outcomes and keep them moving.   
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; you frame decisions with data and are comfortable defining metrics where none exist.   
 Fluent English, written and verbal. Based in India with the ability to work in a hybrid model and collaborate across global time zones.   
 What could set you apart   
 Hands-on exposure to AI-native interfaces – Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tooling, or LLM integrations – and a point of view on where agent-driven finance is heading.   
 Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated environment, and fluency working within compliance, risk, and security constraints.   
 Familiarity with API aggregators and ERP/accounting ecosystems (e.g. Codat, Rutter, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite).   
 Experience productizing an existing internal API surface – governance, standardization, and developer adoption at scale.   
 A builder’s bias: you’ve turned a first customer or first use case into a repeatable, scalable product.   
 The Payoneer Ways of Working   
 Act as our customer’s partner on the inside 
 Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.   
 Do it. Own it. 
 Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.   
 Continuously improve 
 Always striving for a higher standard than our last.   
 Build each other up  
 Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.   
 If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

pennylane:0cfac216-2fb1-4ea6-ab5f-68a07d.desc:
OUR VISION

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.



ABOUT US

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 850+ happy Pennylaners: we're now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 700,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!



WHY THIS POSITION IS OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE TO REACH OUR MISSION

At Pennylane, the product is at the heart of how we grow: it is where our customers discover value, adopt it, and decide to go further with us.

Every month, thousands of SMEs join Pennylane, on their own or through their accountant, and the e-invoicing reform is accelerating this momentum. Our ambition is that each of them quickly finds the value that fits their business, and grows with Pennylane as their needs evolve.

Helping SMEs discover, adopt and upgrade to the right plan is one of the biggest levers for Pennylane's growth in the coming years. As a product-led company, this happens in the product, at the right moment, for the right company. That is the job.

You'll shape this scope from the ground up, with a highly strategic role at the heart of our SME growth and a great opportunity to put your skills and ideas to good use.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - The free-to-paid journey for SMEs: how they discover paid value, when and where an upgrade is proposed, and how they buy (plan upgrade, additional seats, add-ons, opening a Pro Account).

 - The shared upgrade surfaces: paywalls, upsell moments and upgrade guidelines, for a consistent upgrade experience across the product.

 - A clear monetisation outcome: product-driven upgrades and MRR, with a baseline, targets and decision rules you define and steer.

We believe monetisation should come from delivering more value, not from restricting it.



HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE COMPANY AS A PM

As a Product Manager, you'll be part of a 100+ people Product organisation, supported by an engineering team of more than 300 people.

 - You'll spend an extensive amount of time understanding why SMEs pay, or don't. You will interview them, conduct user research and dig into our data yourself (SQL, Amplitude, Metabase) to understand where value is felt and where the upgrade journey breaks.

 - You'll run monetisation as an experiment-led practice: one cohort, one hypothesis, a metric and a stop criterion defined upfront. Weekly hypothesis testing rather than long shaping cycles. You scale, change or stop, and a negative result is still a result.

 - With those insights and the company's objectives in mind, you'll be empowered to define your OKRs and your roadmap.

 - You'll work hand in hand with a Product Designer and Product-centered engineers. You will start with small steps (we like the MVP approach!) and will follow-up on the implementation and future iterations. For us, achieving a common goal matters more than just building features.

 - You'll work closely with the PMs who own each product scope (invoicing, expenses, banking, etc.). They own their jobs to be done; you bring the monetisation lens and the shared upgrade surfaces, and help them place the right paid moment in their flows. Much of your impact comes from influence without authority.

 - You'll measure the impact of what we ship and to align on what we push, to whom, and when.
   


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM YOUR LIFE AT PENNYLANE



WITHIN ONE MONTH

 - You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week

 - You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)

 - You'll understand our current funnel: where SMEs come from, which plans they are on, and what already converts today

 - You'll get a very deep knowledge of our Product organization, methods, and culture

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System for French SMEs and Accounting Firms — and soon, European ones.

ABOUT US

Pennylane is one of the fastest-growing Fintechs in France — and soon in Europe.

In five years, we have:

 - 💻 Built a groundbreaking accounting and financial platform for SMEs and accounting firms

 - 💰 Raised €225 million from leading investors, including Sequoia

WHY THIS POSITION IS CRITICAL TO OUR MISSION

At Pennylane, Product is at the heart of how we create value for our customers.

We are now making a major bet on AI: not only to automate existing workflows, but also to fundamentally change how people interact with their financial software and extend what the product can do.

Our AI ecosystem is being built across several complementary layers:

 - A shared AI platform, or “harness”, that provides the foundations required to run reliable agents: context, memory, tools, skills, loops, guardrails and observability

 - Studio Coworker, a conversational product experience that helps users analyse information and take action inside Pennylane

 - Autopilot, which automates accounting and financial workflows to reduce manual data entry

 - Studio Builder, the product you will own, enabling users to build and deploy personalised apps, automations and agents on top of Pennylane

Studio Builder is our most ambitious AI product initiative.

The idea is simple but powerful: give customers the ability to extend Pennylane according to their own needs, without requiring them to build everything from scratch. Users should be able to describe what they want to achieve and rely on AI to create, configure and deploy the right experience directly within Pennylane.

This could unlock a new way to use financial software: more personalised, more extensible and increasingly capable of adapting to every company’s specific workflows.

As Senior Product Manager, AI, you will shape this product from the ground up. You will define the vision, understand where AI can create genuine customer value and turn a highly complex technical ambition into a simple, useful and scalable product experience.

You will join one of the key teams shaping the future of Pennylane.

You can also read more about Pennylane’s position at the intersection of AI, accounting and financial software in The New York Times https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/23/business/dealbook/pennylane-ai-accounting-france.html.

THE VISION AND STRATEGY FOR STUDIO BUILDER

You will define how Studio Builder should help customers create, personalise and extend Pennylane.

You will identify the most valuable use cases, understand where customers struggle today and establish a clear product strategy that balances ambition, usability and technical feasibility.


THE END-TO-END BUILDING EXPERIENCE

You will own the experience through which customers:

 - Define what they want to build

 - Configure the relevant data, context, tools and actions

 - Test and iterate on their app, automation or agent

 - Deploy it within Pennylane

 - Monitor its usage and improve it over time


THE FOUNDATIONS OF AN EXTENSIBLE AI PRODUCT

You will work closely with the AI platform team to ensure that Studio Builder makes the underlying capabilities of Pennylane accessible and useful to customers.

This includes thinking deeply about how users interact with:

 - Context and memory

 - Tools and skills

 - Agent loops and workflows

 - Guardrails and permissions

 - Reliability and observability

 - Deployment and iteration


A CLEAR PRODUCT OUTCOME

You will define the metrics that matter and establish how we measure success.

Depending on the stage of the product, this may include:

 - Activation and adoption of Studio Builder

 - Number and quality of apps, automations or agents created

 - Successful deployment and repeated usage

 - Customer value generated through personalised workflows

 - Reliability, trust and user satisfaction

 - Expansion of Pennylane’s product capabilities through customer-built experiences

You will work in a highly collaborative environment with Engineering, Product Design, AI specialists and other Product Managers.

Join us as a Website Product Manager to own conversion strategy on qonto.com http://qonto.com, the primary acquisition engine for 600,000+ businesses across 8 European markets.

You will report to Sarah, our Lead Website PM. This is a hands-on product role inside a dedicated feature squad — you'll work daily with Growth Engineers and Designers, not just coordinate from a distance.



➡️ What you'll do

 - Own a section of qonto.com end-to-end: You'll be responsible for a defined part of the website — from identifying conversion problems to shipping the fixes. That means defining the strategy, running the sprints, and tracking the impact.

 - Run a continuous experimentation cycle: Set up and analyse A/B tests using tools like AB Tasty or VWO, draw conclusions from GA4 and Contentsquare data, and iterate fast. You'll be expected to have tests running at all times.

 - Align cross-functional stakeholders: You'll work weekly with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Legal, and the French market. Getting alignment without authority is part of the job.

 - Promote Qonto's products on the website: Work with product teams to translate new features into compelling, conversion-optimised website experiences — landing pages, navigation flows, upsell surfaces.

 - Benchmark and bring new ideas: Regularly analyse competitor websites and best-in-class B2B SaaS sites to identify opportunities Qonto hasn't tried yet.



➡️ What we're looking for

 - 3-4 years of PM experience: You've shipped features end-to-end and can show the before/after on a metric. B2B SaaS or growth-focused product experience is a strong plus.

 - Hands-on with web analytics and CRO tools: You've used GA4, Contentsquare, Hotjar, or equivalent. You can pull your own data, spot patterns, and build a hypothesis without waiting for an analyst.

 - A/B testing methodology: You know how to size a test, define a success metric, and avoid common pitfalls (peeking, underpowered tests). You've run tests that failed and learned from them.

 - Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.

 - Working language: English and French fluency is required. Italian, Spanish, German or Dutch is a genuine plus given our 8-market scope.



➡️ What we can offer you

 - A website that is actually the product: At Qonto, qonto.com is not a marketing brochure — it's the #1 source of new customers. The PM who owns conversion has direct revenue impact, which means your work gets attention and resources.

 - A real feature team: You'll work in a squad with dedicated Growth Engineers and Designers — daily standups, weekly sprints, shared OKRs. You're not a lone PM throwing specs over a wall.

 - 8 markets, real complexity: The website serves France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, and Austria — with different regulatory contexts, languages, and user behaviours. That's a genuine product challenge, not a copy-paste localisation exercise.

 - A test-and-learn culture with senior support: Bamby brings nearly 20 years of product and growth leadership. You'll get autonomy on execution and direct access to someone who has built products at scale — a combination that's harder to find than it sounds.

 Own end to end product outcomes for AP AI Specialist end to end

 ServiceNow's Security & Risk Unit is at the forefront of AI-powered security innovation, delivering solutions that help enterprise customers detect, respond to, and remediate security threats at scale. As our AI security business continues its rapid growth trajectory, we're expanding our product management team to drive the next generation of AI in Security Incident Response and AI-to-AI security integrations.  
 As a Sr. Principal Product Manager, you'll lead product strategy and execution of deploying AI features in Security Incident Response (SIR) – while working closely with our large customer base, and partner ecosystem, to ensure customers successfully deploy, and gain value of existing AI solutions. 
 You’ll also own integrating ServiceNow's AI security solutions with third-party AI systems from leading partners & vendors. You'll be instrumental in defining how ServiceNow’s AI agents communicate and collaborate across security platforms, enabling customers to orchestrate Agentic Incident Response (AIR) workflows across their entire security ecosystem.  
 What you get to do in this role:   
 Own a significant portion of the AI product Roadmap for Security Incident Response (SIR), and transform requirements into customer-centric solutions 
 Set technical and strategic direction that Engineering, UX, and Sales align to with visibility into VP-level roadmap decisions 
 Focus on driving measurable improvement in customer adoption of AI-powered capabilities in SIR (adoption in production, growth in MAUs, renewals) 
 Lead product strategy for AI-to-AI security integrations that support ServiceNow's growth, defining how autonomous AI agents collaborate across security platforms  
 Work directly with customers & partners in regular strategic meetings to align on solutions, integration, differentiation, and value propositions  
 Communicate priorities clearly across Engineering, Design (UX), Architecture, and partner teams, and own execution / shipping. 
 Translate complex AI and security workflows into clear, actionable product requirements 
 Incorporate customer research, usability insights, and market analysis into product decisions 
 Drive cross-functional collaboration and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, UX, leadership, and partner ecosystems  
 To be successful in this role you have: 
 AI-first mindset – demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, OpenAI, Gemini) to accelerate product management work across requirements analysis, decision-making, analytics/insights, and workflow automation 
 8+ years of software product management experience, preferably in cybersecurity, SecOps, AI/ML or related domains  
 Proven track record defining and capturing product requirements and transforming them into executable product roadmaps  
 Strong prioritization skills and the discipline to focus on high-impact activities in fast-paced, high-growth environment  
 Deep curiosity about customer needs with a demonstrated track record building customer relationships and delivering customer-centric security solutions  
 Experience managing stakeholder relationships with external partners and building successful integrations with established or emerging tech or security vendors   
 Excellent communication skills with ability to translate complex technical problems into easily understood requirements for diverse audiences  
 Experience leading teams and mentoring junior PMs, helping elevate product thinking and execution quality across the organization  
 Experience in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol is preferred   
 Experience with AI agent communication protocols, API design, or distributed automation frameworks is preferred

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. snyk:62b7431d-586c-4c8f-b0f2-28e1ee81400.title: Staff Product Manager
snyk:62b7431d-586c-4c8f-b0f2-28e1ee81400.desc:
UNLEASH AI INNOVATORS, SECURELY

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate.  It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 - Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 - Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 - Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 - You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 - You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 - You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 - You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.




IT’D BE AWESOME IF YOU ALSO…

 - Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 - Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 - Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 - Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 - Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.


ABOUT SNYK

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

spotify:03437e2a-2d5e-4593-9e97-11271014.title: Product Manager - Data Platform
spotify:03437e2a-2d5e-4593-9e97-11271014.desc:
Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.
Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.
We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

What You'll Do
Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
 Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.

You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
