 Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
 Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
 Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
 Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

 You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
 You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
 You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
 You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.
 About the role 
 Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.
 We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.
 This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.

 Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines
 Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality
 Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol
 Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature
 Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement
 Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers
 Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks
 Who you are 
 Required 
 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain
 Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America
 Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture
 Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions
 Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs
 Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority
 Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences
 Nice to have 
 Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform
 Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products
 Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)

 Does Stripe Tax support the taxes and business models that apply to me?
 Can it calculate tax accurately for my registrations, exemptions, customers, products, and fulfillment model?
 Is it fast, reliable, and easy for my team to operate?
 Does it work with the other Stripe products, platforms, and integrations my business depends on?
 Who you are 
 You are a product leader who is comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes spaces where customer needs, regulatory complexity, technical constraints, and commercial opportunity intersect. You can translate a broad mission into a focused strategy, build alignment across teams, and deliver meaningful products over multiple horizons.
 You likely have:
 Significant product management experience, including ownership of complex, platform-oriented, or technically deep products.
 A track record of setting strategy and delivering multi-team initiatives with measurable business and customer impact.
 Strong judgment in prioritizing across customer needs, market opportunities, operational complexity, and engineering investment.
 Experience working closely with engineering and design partners to build reliable, scalable products.
 The ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders and to align diverse partners around a shared direction.
 Curiosity about global commerce, financial infrastructure, tax, compliance, payments, marketplaces, or developer platforms. Direct domain experience is helpful but not required.
 A customer-first mindset and the ability to turn complex requirements into simple, effective product experiences.
 Why this role 
 Tax is a fundamental challenge for businesses that sell across borders, channels, and business models. Stripe Tax has the opportunity to remove that complexity, helping businesses launch faster, expand with confidence, and operate globally.
 This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of global commerce, financial infrastructure, and product platform strategy. You will shape how Stripe Tax evolves to serve the next generation of internet businesses.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

stripe:8231234.title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange
stripe:8231234.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach. 
 About the team 
 The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.
 Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.
 Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.
 A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.
 This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.
 Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.
 We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.
 What you’ll do 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.
 You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.
 You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.
 Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.
 You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.
 The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.
 You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.
 Responsibilities 
 Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX a

stripe:8267105.title: Product Manager, Global Self-Serve Product
stripe:8267105.desc:
Product Manager, Global Self-Serve Product
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Global Self-Serve Product team's goal is to make Stripe the #1 self-serve financial infrastructure provider for users outside the U.S. We drive product-led growth for the millions of users who adopt Stripe without a sales relationship, and we own self-serve activation goals across our ex-US business.
 We're a cross-functional team of Engineers, Data Scientists, Growth Marketing Managers, Designers, and Product Managers, organized around three focus areas:
 Growing our self-serve domestic business across a portfolio of our core, mature markets
 Growing cross-border self-serve business across the next wave of emerging markets and launching bespoke registration, onboarding and upsell pathways for new markets
 Raising the bar on the quality of the localized experience of our international users by building and improving our localization platform at scale
 About the role
 Most of Stripe's future users outside the US will never speak to a salesperson—they'll discover, sign up, and scale on Stripe entirely on their own. Getting that self-serve journey right, in every market and language, is one of the biggest growth opportunities ahead of us.
 We're looking for a Product Manager to own self-serve activation and growth across our ex-US business. You'll set the strategy for how we win self-serve users in international markets and then make it real—turning funnel data and customer insight into a sequenced roadmap, and shipping the experiments and features that move the metrics.
 The right person for this role thinks like a growth PM and a founder: you're fluent in funnels and experimentation, you have genuine taste for 0-to-1 product, and you move fast under ambiguity. You bring deep user empathy to localizing Stripe with contextual relevance, and you think in systems and platforms—turning experimental features into scaled growth levers 
 What you'll do
 Own the self-serve growth roadmap: identify the highest-leverage opportunities to grow activation across our ex-US markets, and build the case for investment
 Build a deep understanding of our customers—from bootstrapped solopreneurs to well-funded founders—synthesizing funnel metrics, experiment results, and time in the product into sharp hypotheses about what will drive growth
 Partner with engineering to ship—you'll drive specs, prioritization, and execution with a high degree of hands-on involvement, and run experiments to build conviction in your roadmap
 Scale what works: take wins proven in small samples and roll them out through our localization and recommendation platforms, so the right experience reaches each market and use case
 Collaborate with Stripe's global product teams to ensure regional needs are reflected in platform decisions, and advocate for regional investment at the right moments
 Who you are
 You have 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent shipping 0-to-1 products
 You reason from first principles—breaking ambiguous growth problems down to fundamentals, forming a sharp point of view, and moving fast under uncertainty with the ownership of a founder
 You're data-savvy: fluent in funnels, metrics, and experimentation, you let the numbers sharpen your instincts, and you know when a test earns conviction and when it only adds noise
 You have strong product taste and are technically comfortable—you sweat the details of a localized experience (message clarity, contextual guidance) and can engage credibly with engineers on API design and system tradeoffs
 You're an exceptional communicator—verbal and written—who can influence without authority across a matrixed organization
 You're based in Singapore or have a strong reason to be
 Why Stripe
 Stripe is still early in its presence outside the US, which means the person in this role will have genuine influence over how we show up in some of the world's most important emerging markets. You'll have the scope of a startup with the resources of a company that processes hundreds of billions of dollars a year.

synthesia:31e1dca3-74fd-4f74-8f40-5bb19f.title: Product Manager, Enterprise (Staff/Principal-level)
synthesia:31e1dca3-74fd-4f74-8f40-5bb19f.desc:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100, and the largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar, it is whether admins, legal, and programme owners can actually stay in control. 

You'll own that layer end to end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.


WHY THIS ROLE NOW

AI video has crossed from experiment to standard tooling inside the world's biggest companies. The next phase of growth is won or lost on whether we can make that scale safe and manageable. That is your remit.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the end-to-end roadmap for content lifecycle, governance, and the operational layer that keeps enterprise deployments running - from workspace setup through compliance controls

 - Getting close to enterprise customers: understanding how IT admins, legal teams, programme managers and content owners think about governance, and what "in control" actually looks like at scale

 - Translating that into clear product direction, what to build, in what order, and why, and keeping engineering and design aligned to it as the strategy evolves

 - Working closely with the engineering manager and designer in the team; writing clear specs, making good calls on trade-offs, and providing the context that helps engineers build the right thing first time

 - Partnering with Solutions, CS, and Legal on complex enterprise deals. These features are frequently deal-critical and the commercial loop matters

 - Defining the metrics that tell us whether this layer is working: adoption of admin tooling, compliance feature usage, reduction in support escalations related to governance gaps


WHO YOU ARE

You've excited by the challenge that comes with untangling the inherent complexity of enterprise platform products. You understand that governance and compliance work isn't glamorous, but you know it's the difference between a proof of concept and a seven-figure renewal.

You can hold a conversation with a CISO and with a content creator, and understand what each of them needs from the same system.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU BRING

 - Significant experience owning a critical product domain - setting strategy, not just executing it

 - A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent

 - Comfortable working across a broad surface area. You can prioritise ruthlessly and make the case for what gets built next

 - Strong written communication: PRDs, strategy docs, and customer insight summaries that others can act on without a follow-up

 - Ability to ramp quickly on to the complexity of enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team on complex deals and that context matters

 - Based in London or open to regular travel; the team is London-anchored and in-person time matters

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.




OUR CULTURE

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. https://www.notion.so/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2?pvs=21




LOCATION

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office or remote from Europe.  

 


GLOBAL BENEFITS:

 - You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. 

 - You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

 - Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person. 

 - Work from home budget 

 - Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

 - Generous referral

synthesia:c2ba6d4d-f991-4432-a9c8-1514a9.desc:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.




WHY NOW

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.




THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

 - Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

 - Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

 - Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

 - Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

 - Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

 - Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

 - Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

 - Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

synthesia:e934a7ac-b668-46c0-9953-eed450.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
synthesia:e934a7ac-b668-46c0-9953-eed450.desc:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.

This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.

 


THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING

Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.

We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 - Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 - Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 - Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 - Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 - Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business


WHO YOU ARE

You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.

You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.

You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference live

toast:8177652.title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
toast:8177652.desc:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 The Embedded Finance team is responsible for a diverse range of products, all with the united goal of building a financial operating system integrated into Toast merchants’ daily operations, that delivers unparalleled cash control, capital access, and financial intelligence, powered by an always-on AI finance team. 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to bring that mission to life for operators. You’ll own the Financial Products page and the Finance tab in the Toast Now app , the shared spaces where our Embedded Finance products come together to form one financial operating system. You’ll work across Embedded Finance product teams to set best practices for how products show up in these spaces, and to make sure they deliver the key jobs-to-be-done across cash control, capital access, and financial intelligence. This is an end-to-end owner role: strategy, roadmap, experimentation, execution, and accountability for measurable business outcomes. Expect to run a lot of experiments.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)  
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of the Financial Products page and the Finance tab in Toast Now, including how operators discover, evaluate, and engage with financial products.
 Define the key jobs-to-be-done these shared spaces must serve (e.g., understanding cash position, accessing funds, discovering the right product, acting on insights) and turn them into prioritized roadmaps that move KPIs.
 Translate our vision and mission into the customer experience, so that cash control, capital access, and financial intelligence feel like one connected system rather than separate products.
 Partner with product teams across Embedded Finance to establish and enforce best practices, such as design patterns, content standards, entry points, and measurement, so products show up consistently and the experience feels cohesive.
 Run a high-velocity experimentation program: form hypotheses, design and launch tests (placement, messaging, personalization, sequencing, cross-sell), analyze results, and scale what works.
 Balance the needs of individual product teams against the operator experience and overall business outcomes, making clear tradeoffs and resolving competing priorities.
 Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Research to write user stories, define requirements, workflows, and wireframes. Manage the backlog and facilitate agile ceremonies.
 Partner with GTM and Product Marketing to drive awareness, adoption, and attach across financial products, and coordinate launches with the teams who own the underlying products.
 Define success metrics, build dashboards, and own outcomes such as engagement with the Finance tab and page, discovery-to-activation conversion, cross-product attach, retention, time saved for operators, and customer satisfaction.
 Run VoC and customer interviews, and turn insights into roadmap decisions.
 Create and present business cases for new investments and quantify the impact of launches.
 Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 A passion for innovating in financial services and a desire to transform the restaurant and hospitality industry.
 Experience owning a product or surface from early inception to measurable post-launch success, ideally a platform, hub, or shared experience spanning multiple products.
 Hands-on experience running experimentation programs (A/B testing, hypothesis-driven iteration) and using the results to drive decisions.
 Ability to influence without authority: setting standards and best practices across teams you don’t manage, and aligning stakeholders with competing priorities.
 Customer obsession, with experience running VoC and customer interviews and turning insights into prioritized roadmaps.
 A track record of strong execution, delivering both speed and quality.
 Comfort with analyzing data, building funnels, and defining analytics.
 **This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in the Dublin office**

toast:8226800.desc:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.
 About the role 
 Toast IQ Grow combines intelligent marketing tools with dedicated expert support to help restaurants reach more guests, bring them back, and grow sales. The Marketing Tools team builds the campaign products underlying Toast IQ Grow - one of the fastest-growing products in Toast's history. Every campaign created by a restaurant, a Toast marketing specialist or the Toast IQ Marketing Agent uses what this team builds.
 Our purpose is simple: 
 Build AI-powered marketing automation that drives orders and revenue for restaurants
 Give users the advanced tools they need to run best-in-class marketing programs
 Maintain a platform that scales seamlessly with billions of messages going out a year
 We operate like a startup within Toast: fast-moving, customer-obsessed, and relentlessly focused on impact and results.
 What you’ll do 
 This role is an incredible opportunity for a product leader who wants to shape how restaurants market in an AI-first world, on a platform that already sends billions of messages. Responsibilities include:
 Marketing automation: Lead the vision, strategy and roadmap for Toast's marketing experiences across email, SMS and social. Partner with our CRM team and own the marketing use cases that move restaurants from one-off sends to always-on campaigns that run themselves. 
 Advanced tooling: Build the power-user layer for Toast's marketing specialists, multi-location brands, and sophisticated operators, including bulk and multi-location workflows, advanced scheduling and segmentation. Keep the core experience simple for everyone else.
 AI: Partner with the Toast IQ Marketing Agent team so that AI-generated campaigns are easy to review, edit, approve, and trust. Find where AI can remove work across the campaign lifecycle.

 Teamwork: Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to define and deliver high-impact features.
 Customer empathy: Drive deep understanding through interviews, testing, analytics and insights, so we solve real problems for restaurants and the specialists who support them.
 What we’re looking for 
 You love solving complex problems and embrace an iterative mindset. You are grounded in customer feedback and cross-functional partnership, and you can turn customer needs and product vision into world-class experiences. The ideal candidate has: 
 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of driving strategy, execution, and impact for B2B products
 Experience building platform products at scale, ideally in SaaS martech (email, SMS, push, or social)
 Experience building for both power users and novice users, and the judgment to know when to add flexibility and when to simplify
 Hands-on curiosity about AI and agentic products, and active use of AI tools in your own work
 Strong ability to turn data into actionable insights and customer outcomes
 Proven ability to influence across teams and drive alignment in ambiguous, high-impact spaces

toast:8263535.desc:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 We're looking for a Product Manager for Fraud & Risk who wants to understand how fraud really happens and to build products that stop it at scale. You're comfortable with ambiguity and you like hard trade-offs, like loss vs. friction or automation vs. human review. Your decisions rest on data, customer insight and strong cross-functional partnerships. And last, but not least, you know that a team succeeds because of its people, and you want to help build an environment where we can all do our best work.
 This is a chance to shape the risk platform behind one of the largest restaurant payments businesses in the US. You'll use machine learning and AI to protect restaurants and help Toast grow. 
 Who We Are 
 The Fraud & Risk team keeps Toast, our restaurants and their guests safe from fraud and financial loss. We also make it fast and easy for restaurants to get onboarded and get paid. The team owns:
 Merchant onboarding and underwriting (KYC/KYB)
 Transaction and payout risk monitoring
 The fraud rules and decisioning platform
 Settlement reserves
 Chargebacks and disputes
 Our job is to balance loss prevention against growth. We stop bad actors without adding friction for the great majority of restaurants that are doing the right thing. We work closely with Risk Operations, Payments, Compliance and Legal. We operate like a small startup with high ambitions and a focus on speed, experimentation and iteration.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)  
 Drive and prioritize the roadmap for your area of Fraud & Risk. Balance fraud loss reduction, merchant experience and business growth.
 Set the strategy for detecting and preventing fraud across the merchant lifecycle: onboarding, payments, payouts and disputes.
 Partner with data science and engineering to improve risk models, rules and decisioning. Define the right trade-offs between catching fraud and avoiding false positives.
 Build AI-driven automation that scales our risk and chargeback operations, such as agent-assisted reviews and automated dispute responses.
 Understand the needs of restaurants, their guests and our internal Risk Operations analysts. Use customer conversations, investigations, data analysis, ops feedback and industry intelligence.
 Define and own success metrics such as fraud loss rates, chargeback rates and win rates, auto-approval rates and operational efficiency.
 Work with Compliance, Legal, Payments and external partners such as processors, card networks and risk vendors to deliver solutions that are compliant and scalable.
 Write clear product requirements and work closely with designers and engineers to bring them to life.
 Be a great teammate, always.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in fraud, risk, payments, fintech, or trust & safety
 A working knowledge of the payments ecosystem: card networks, processors and acquirers, chargebacks and disputes, and KYC/KYB
 Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable digging into data yourself, with SQL as a strong plus, and you understand how ML models and rules engines make decisions.
 Sound judgment in weighing risk against customer friction, and the ability to make good calls with incomplete information, including during live fraud incidents
 Proven ownership of a product that supports company strategy and meets defined business objectives
 A track record of working well with cross-functional partners, especially operations, compliance and legal teams
 The ability to thrive and self-prioritize across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
 Active use of AI tools and best practices in your own work to drive efficiency
 Exceptional attention to detail
 Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

trustpilot:8236554.desc:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!
 We need an experienced and skilled Senior Product Manager to lead one of our key product areas. Working in a cross-functional product squad, you will drive innovation and product evolution in a world where the technologies consumers are using to make decisions are changing faster than ever before by defining new, ambiguous problem spaces.
 If you are passionate about driving innovation, eager to take ownership of significant projects, and keen on making a global impact, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for. Join Trustpilot's Product Management team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic and rapidly growing organization. Together, let's push the boundaries of what's possible in the Product space and create a lasting impact on our users worldwide. 
 What you'll be doing: 
 Lead cross-functional agile teams, including remote members, through the entire product lifecycle for complex products
 Take ownership of long-term product discovery, strategic roadmaps, and execution while aligning them with business goals and customer needs
 Collaborate with designers, engineers, data scientists, and other key senior stakeholders to develop new features and optimize existing products
 Prioritize new features and enhancements using robust product management frameworks
 Conduct in-depth user research and leverage data insights to identify ambiguous, strategic opportunities and define new product visions
 Drive decision-making by setting clear priorities and using data (quantitative and qualitative) to measure success
 Communicate product strategy, status updates, and potential risks to executive leadership and internal teams, ensuring strategic alignment across the business
 Cultivate solid connections between the sales, marketing, and customer service departments to proactively lead change and promote product-focused mindsets across the organisation
 Inspire and motivate teams to achieve their best performance, establishing a culture of high collaboration and innovation, and mentoring more junior Product Managers
 Who you are: 
 Significant product management experience working within agile teams, with a proven history of driving significant business impact and delivering effective products
 Comprehensive understanding of product management principles, including setting long-term product strategy, owning roadmap development, and agile methodologies
 Demonstrated experience working in cross-functional teams and successfully influencing senior leadership and executive stakeholders, without direct authority
 Expertise in user research, A/B testing, and data analysis to independently define strategic direction and product development
 Skilled in critical assessment and oversight, with expertise in defining, setting up, and supervising key performance indicators and measures of achievement
 Passion for emerging technologies and their potential to transform the product area and user experience
 Great communication and executive-level stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse teams around a common, long-term vision
 What’s in it for you: 
 A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
 Competitive compensation package + bonus
 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment 
 Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
 Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
 Pension and life insurance
 Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7, Employee Assistance Plan
 Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
 Paid parental leave
 Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme

 Twilio is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Product Manager to join our Onboarding and Compliance team for Senders and Numbers. Twilio has numerous different types of Senders and Numbers, which are the gateway to accessing all of Twilio’s communication APIs. It is crucial for customers accessing Senders and Numbers to properly register in accordance with local telecommunications regulations, but we also need to make it easy for customers to gain access. In this role, you will own various Senders and Numbers products where you will aim to create streamlined and lovable onboarding experiences while also maintaining best in class compliance standards.
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll:
 Collect and develop business requirements and collaborate with engineering teams to translate these requirements into user stories
 Partner with cross functional stakeholders to drive product planning, design, execution, and delivery of product investments against defined success metrics
 Develop, communicate, generate excitement for and obtain buy-in of the product vision, strategy, and roadmap
 Partner with GTM to launch products and enable sales and marketing teams to obtain product adoption and growth
 Conduct regular data-driven business reviews that analyze product execution and revenue/market accomplishments.
 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

visa:REF083176W.desc:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
 Job Description 
 The Senior Product Manager, Fleet and Mobility - Key Client serves as a hands-on, embedded technical partner working day-to-day with internal Visa teams and external partners to build, launch, and scale new fleet and mobility solutions, driving successful solution delivery. This role translates Visa platform capabilities - including VIP authorization, clearing, and payment processing frameworks - into clear, actionable implementation guidance, and leads technical problem-solving and solution design across markets and use cases alongside the Key Client.
 Operating within a one-team model across Visa  and our key client, the role accelerates delivery by removing integration blockers, aligning stakeholders, and enabling rapid decision-making. The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in Visa processing and ecosystem integration, brings strong payments and fleet domain knowledge, and has a hands-on execution mindset - able to quickly ramp in as a highly responsive and trusted counterpart to  the client’s team.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Embedded Technical Partnership:
 Serve as a hands-on, embedded technical partner working day-to-day with internal Visa teams and external partners to drive successful solution delivery.
 Operate as a highly responsive counterpart, ensuring consistent engagement and support to partner teams.
 Bring the right internal and external stakeholders together quickly to unblock decisions and accelerate progress.
 Support onboarding and enablement of partners by driving knowledge transfer and implementation best practices and ensuring Visa Client Services/various Visa Implementation teams configure and launch all platforms for successful solution delivery.
 Technical Problem-Solving and Solution Design:
 Translate Visa platform capabilities (e.g., VIP, clearing, payment processing frameworks) into clear, actionable implementation guidance for partners across different markets and use cases.
 Lead technical problem-solving and solution design, providing direction on how to implement Visa capabilities effectively.
 Act as a subject matter expert on Visa processing and ecosystem integration, including issuer and acquirer capabilities and platform constraints.
 Provide guidance on system configurations, dependencies, and limitations, and identify practical paths to achieve desired outcomes.
 Product Strategy and Ownership:
 Direct product strategy from conception and definition through implementation, ensuring alignment with Visa's fleet and mobility platform objectives and the key partner’s roadmap requirements (as per Visa AOP approvals)

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Connectivity Strategy

 - Set the long term vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple connects with the broader financial ecosystem.

 - Define the platform capabilities required for authentication, consent, permissions, data access and partner integrations.

The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision and strategy for the Financial Risk platform, balancing fraud prevention with client experience - every intervention has a cost, and you'll need to make sharp tradeoffs between friction and protection.

 - Drive the roadmap for the Decision Platform, our real-time rules engine that evaluates fraud risk across withdrawals, deposits, e-transfers, crypto transactions, and cheque deposits.

 - Build and improve fraud investigation tooling and automations - including case management workflows, alert deduplication, and enrichment pipelines - that help our fraud operations team investigate and resolve cases faster.

 - Define and evolve the restriction and mitigation framework that enables the right response to fraud signals: suspensions, withdrawal blocks, spend switch blocks, and account-level restrictions.

 - Operate as a platform PM, designing extensible APIs, decision schemas, and integration patterns that payment and money movement teams can reliably plug into as new products and payment rails launch.

 - Partner deeply with Fraud and Data Science teams on fraud model integration, fraud rule development, and the feedback loops that improve detection accuracy over time.

 - Own key risk metrics - fraud loss rates, false positive rates, investigation cycle times, decision latency - and use data to drive prioritization.

 - Break down complex, behind-the-scenes infrastructure projects into discrete phases that deliver value incrementally - this is platform work where the "client" is often another engineering team.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep on streaming architectures, workflow orchestration, and ML model integration. You don't need to write code, but you need to reason about system design tradeoffs with engineering.

That's the mandate for this role: continue to expand Wealthsimple’s growth upmarket. Convincing millions of Canadians to consolidate their financial lives at Wealthsimple is the mission we've been on for over 10 years, and we're looking for someone who can lead the next phase of this work and own it end to end.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help define the product vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple wins and serves high-net-worth clients, and own the roadmap to bring it to life.

 - Lead the planning, development, launch, and iteration of a step change in our Tiers program. The service, product depth, and recognition that makes a client choose us as their primary financial institution.

 - Build the personalized experiences that compel clients to consolidate: understanding a client's current financial life and making the case, in-product, for moving it to Wealthsimple.

We have made great progress in developing a general crime catching machine learning model, and now we need to dig deeper, and get a whole lot more specific. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that catch hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.
 About the team 
 The AML Squad works across our offices in London and Tallinn. We are growing the Squad, and adding new teams to make faster progress in our fight against crime.

 You’ll be joining one of the cross-functional product teams in the squad focused on detection.
 We measure success by two metrics: AML Recall and Cost of Suspicious Activity Report (SAR).
 AML Recall measures how much of the crime we actually catch. We want this to be as high as possible, and are rapidly expanding our coverage of hyper specific crime detection in addition to our already strong general model.
 Cost of SAR measures how much it costs us to detect, investigate and report a criminal to the relevant authorities. We want this to be as low as possible, and are investing a lot in high precision automation including some cool stuff with LLMs.

wolt:8164157.title: Product Manager, Homepage
wolt:8164157.desc:
About Wolt 
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 
 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.
 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.
 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.
 What You'll Need to Thrive 
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.
 Next steps
 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 
 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 
 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

xendit:8032565003.desc:
Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. We give companies one unified platform for payment acceptance, payouts, treasury and financial services, replacing fragmented local integrations with a single infrastructure layer. We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.
 The Role 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the next generation of XenPlatform. XenPlatform is one of the most complex products in Xendit’s payment processing stack. Your main job will be to set its overall product direction and make sure we can serve marketplaces and platforms across all our regions.
 Beyond long-term strategy, we need someone who can get into the weeds and break complex problems down for our engineering teams. You’ll bring payments experience, a track record of building global products at scale, and strong commercial judgement, so that what we build covers all our markets and scales sustainably.
 You’ll have full ownership of your team’s strategy, priorities and outcomes, and the autonomy to define the next phase of XenPlatform.
 What you’ll do in this role 
 Drive the overall product strategy and roadmap, balancing competing stakeholder requests across teams and clearly communicating your prioritisation framework to senior leadership
 Deeply understand enterprise customers across segments (marketplaces, embedded finance and SaaS platforms), leveraging their feedback to define your longer-term roadmap
 Partner with Finance, Compliance, Legal and GTM to define the ideal customer profile (ICP) Xendit should focus on
 Design intuitive experiences across the API and the Xendit Dashboard, so merchants can clearly see how their platforms are performing and accurately reconcile their own data
 Build scalable account structures that accurately reflect how our enterprise merchants’ organisations are set up
 Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver products and features on time and to a high standard, making sure every XenPlatform feature is on par with or better than what’s in the market
 What you’ll need in this role
 5+ years of product management experience in fintech and/or B2B products
 Experience in payments processing (acquiring/issuing) or cross-border payouts
 Experience with onboarding and KYC/KYB flows
 A track record of driving roadmap and execution across cross-functional teams, owning north-star metrics such as TPV, conversion or retention
 Strong understanding of the technical, regulatory and operational challenges of building global financial products
 A clear, concise communication style that adapts to your audience
 Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to understand customer behaviour and make decisions
 Strong commercial acumen, with the judgement to balance commercial and product requirements

ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.


Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.




If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.



Location Portugal | Compensation package €75,000 - €90,000 base + Bonus + Share Options + Benefits | Ways of working remote with quarterly visits to our London office



About the Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Product Manager to own Telematics at Zego. Our proprietary telematics is how we understand the way people actually drive, and the ratings it produces shape pricing, risk management and claims across our whole book.

You’ll own the telematics stack as a product: the SDKs that capture driving data, the processing that turns it into trips, events and scores, and the Risk Management capabilities that act on them. You’ll set the 6-12 month direction across these teams and make the build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls on sensors, data sources and models.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Pricing, Claims and Zego’s Leadership Team, champion an experiment-first culture, and mentor Product Managers across the organisation.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - Set the six-to-12-month Telematics strategy across the SDKs, data processing and Risk Management, including the build, buy or partner calls on sensors, data and models.

 - Own data quality at the source, setting the standards for trip recording, location accuracy, battery impact and stability that every score depends on.

 - Own the product side of our scoring models with Data Science, so the score is accurate, explainable and safe to change on a live book.

 - Lead Risk Management, defining how we act on driving behaviour - from price adjustments to interventions and cancellations - balancing loss ratio with fair customer outcomes.

 - Turn driving data into P&L impact with Pricing, Underwriting, Claims and Fraud, through sharper risk selection, fairer prices and better fraud detection.

 - Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, even when changes touch price and live policies.

 - Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team’s output, from trip-data analysis to automated data and model monitoring.

 - Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.



What You’ll Need to Be Successful

 - Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.

 - Data, sensor or ML products. You’ve built products on behavioural, location or sensor data - ideally telematics, mobility or IoT - and understand how signals become models, and models become decisions.

 - Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on mobile SDKs, data pipelines and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.

 - Commercial and risk fluency. Deep understanding of pricing levers, risk modelling and loss ratios, and credible with Actuarial, Finance and Leadership.

 - Data mastery. You are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review, and you can interrogate model performance, not just read a dashboard.

 - Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests.

 - You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.



Pay Transparency

At Zego, we are committed to pay transparency and equal pay practices. In compliance with EU pay transparency regulations, we proactively disclose salary information for all open positions to ensure fairness and clarity in our recruitment process. We believe transparency builds trust and helps candidates make informed decisions about their careers with us.

You’ll own strategic workstreams that span multiple teams and business domains, defining the 6-12 month product direction and shaping how Zego’s products evolve to meet ambitious commercial targets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You’ll define new product mechanics and revenue models. You’ll make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations that shape Zego’s competitive position. And you’ll champion an experiment-first culture - using AI to compress discovery cycles, generate sharper insights, and ship at a velocity that sets the standard for the rest of the organisation.

 - Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, so rate of learning replaces opinion as the leading metric.

 - Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team's output, not just your own.

 - Design the product metrics and dashboards the business runs on, and use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground every strategic decision.

 - Own company-level programmes with direct P&L impact, accountable for commercial outcomes rather than feature delivery.

 - Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

Job Description
 Are you the kind of product leader who gets energy from turning a great product into a growth engine?
If you've built product-led experiences that actually moved the needle on revenue and retention and you want to do it at scale, in a role that sits at the heart of company strategy, this is your opportunity.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who will architect the experiences that bring customers in, help them succeed, and grow with us, making our product the primary driver of how we acquire and retain customers.
 This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week. 
 About the team 
You'll join a forward-thinking, collaborative product organisation focused on delivering exceptional experiences for Customer and Employee Service teams. You'll be part of a small but high-impact group of PMs in Pune, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success across locations.
 The opportunity 
Our ambition is bold: build the most powerful self-serve growth experience in our category. That means turning our product into the primary driver of new and expansion revenue, designing experiences that make it effortless for customers to discover, adopt, and expand and connecting product signals with sales and customer success to maximise retention.
As the PM driving this, you'll set the vision, lead execution, and shape how we use AI to move faster and smarter.
 What you'll do 
 Own the growth roadmap: Define the product strategy for your area, tying every initiative to clear revenue and retention targets with measurable hypotheses and expected outcomes.
 Deliver a best-in-class self-serve experience: Design and optimise the full customer journey: sign-up, onboarding, activation, upsell, and expansion. Build in-product experiences that drive real conversion and growth.
 Build the PM community in Pune: Establish shared standards for research, experimentation, and storytelling that raise the bar for the whole team.
 Use AI responsibly: Identify and deliver high-value use cases for AI across onboarding, workflows, and recommendations.
 What you bring 
 8+ years in B2B SaaS product management, with proven success driving growth motions that directly impacted revenue and retention.
 Strong experience with workflow, customer service, or employee experience products (e.g. support, ticketing, CRM, or similar).
 A track record of defining and tracking metrics across the full funnel from sign-up through to expansion and churn, and running A/B experiments.
 Experience influencing beyond your immediate team, partnering effectively with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering across time zones.
 Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex ideas into clear narratives for executives and cross-functional partners.
 A clear point of view on responsible, value-driven AI usage.
 Why this role matters 
This isn't a supporting role, it's a core lever for how we acquire, grow, and retain customers in the next phase of our journey. If you want to build an industry-defining growth experience and shape how growth is built into the product experience in customer and employee service, this is for you.
 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based. 
 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager. 
 The intelligent heart of customer experience 
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
