zip:b9a66bf7-d4f0-4522-9ad2-67c00060090e.desc:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a Principal Product Manager on the Payments team, you will own the systems and strategy that power Zip's global payments infrastructure and make Zip the safest and most seamless way to pay vendors across tens of billions in annual spend. You will drive product development across the payments platform -- including bank integrations, payment provider partnerships, payout management, and payment routing -- as well as payment controls covering risk and fraud prevention, bank account verification, payment onboarding, currency management, and payment compliance. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Payment Operations, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable payment infrastructure, proactively mitigate payment fraud, ensure smooth and secure payment onboarding, and manage payment compliance with confidence at enterprise scale.




YOU WILL

 - Own the payments platform strategy and roadmap, including direct bank integrations, payment provider partnerships, and payment routing infrastructure that supports tens of billions in annual volume across 40+ currencies and 130+ countries

 - Drive the product strategy and roadmap to reduce payment risk -- including Zip's AI-powered fraud detection system that flags risky invoices directly to customers

 - Own bank account verification– expanding provider coverage, increasing geographic reach, and ensuring reliable real-time verification across customer segments.

 - Lead payments onboarding automation – building customer-facing workflows that reduce manual operational overhead and accelerate go-live.

 - Define product strategy for payment method management to help buyers and vendors transact seamlessly, including multi-provider support and payout group management.

 - Lead payments platform modernization -- expanding payment rails and payout capabilities, improving payment cycle times, and ensuring enterprise-grade reliability at scale.

 - Drive currency localization across Zip – enabling customers to support multi-currency workflows across all payment surfaces.

 - Collaborate deeply with engineering and design to define requirements, provide product direction, make tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality, enterprise-grade payment capabilities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of product management and 10+ years of overall professional experience; experience working on payments infrastructure, fintech, bank integrations, risk/fraud, or financial compliance is a requirement.

 - Ability to break down complex payment and risk problems into structured components and deliver clear product recommendations.

 - Technical fluency with the ability to partner effectively with engineering on integration architectures, API design, payment processing systems, and data-driven risk systems.

 - Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, and drive alignment across engineering, design, operations, and customer-facing teams.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to drive product decisions, measure fraud metrics, and evaluate risk model performance.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Bias to action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.



The salary range for this role is $195,000-$242,000 CAD. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise. This posting is for a current vacancy.

As part of our hiring process, Zip uses AI-enabled tools to assist in screening and assessing candidates, including resume review and interview documentation. All hiring decisions are made by people.

zscaler:5122174007.desc:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
 Role 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director WW Field PM in the Data Security Product Organization department. 
 As a key member of the Data Security Product Organization, you will focus on growing and sustaining core business revenue across the APJ region, with a special emphasis on our AI-powered data security product lines. 
 You will partner closely with Product Management and Sales leadership to drive field engagements and provide technical and commercial expertise to Sales Engineers and Account Executives throughout the customer lifecycle. Additionally, you will play a critical role in shaping platform evolution by translating real-world customer feedback from the field to solve emerging AI and data security challenges.
 What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 
 Drive the sales strategy and execution for the Data Security product suite specifically for our APJ customer base, assisting with opportunities to demonstrate technical superiority and business value
 Partner with Product Management leadership to translate field insights into product strategy & roadmap by leading competitive analysis, win/loss reviews, customer commitment tracking, pricing planning, and pipeline and churn analysis across the DLP, DSPM, and AI portfolio
 Enable and educate the broader Zscaler field team to effectively position and sell Data Security solutions within their accounts
 Work with support leadership to provide timely assistance to large customers in event of escalations and deployment of Zscaler services
 Provide clear, concise, and data-driven updates on deal status, pipeline health, business performance, and key risks to Sales and Product leadership, enabling informed decision-making
 Who You Are (Success Profile) 
 You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
 You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
 You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
 You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
 You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.
 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 
 Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 Proven professional experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as a Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, or Product Manager
 Deep expertise in Data Security technologies like Cloud DLP, Inline DLP, CASB, Email/Endpoint DLP, DSPM, AISPM, SSPM, and securing AI agents
 Deep understanding of SWG, ZTNA, proxies, firewalls, VPN, Secure Browser, and authentication/identity protocols such as SAML and SCIM
 Subject matter expertise in infrastructure deployment within a major public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting using modern project management tools to track engagement and activity
 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
